title: The Book of Numbers Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Numbers — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the Sinai wilderness, in the meeting tent, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

verses.kjv: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of their names, every male by their polls;
verses.decoded: Take a census of the entire assembly of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers' households, with the count of their names, every male individually.

verses.kjv: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.
verses.decoded: From twenty years old and older, everyone in Israel who is able to go to war: you and Aaron are to count them by their military units.

verses.kjv: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.
verses.decoded: And with you there will be a man from every tribe; each one the head of his ancestral household.

verses.kjv: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.decoded: And these are the names of the men who will stand with you: from the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.

verses.kjv: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.decoded: From the tribe of Simeon: Shelumiel, the son of Zurishaddai.

verses.kjv: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.decoded: From the tribe of Judah, Nahshon, the son of Amminadab.

verses.kjv: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
verses.decoded: From Issachar, Nethaneel, the son of Zuar.

verses.kjv: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.decoded: From Zebulun, Eliab the son of Helon.

verses.kjv: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.decoded: From the descendants of Joseph: from Ephraim, Elishama, the son of Ammihud; from Manasseh, Gamaliel, the son of Pedahzur.

verses.kjv: Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.decoded: From Asher, Pagiel, the son of Ocran.

verses.kjv: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.decoded: From Dan; Ahiezer, the son of Ammishaddai.

verses.kjv: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.decoded: From Asher, Pagiel, the son of Ocran.

verses.kjv: Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
verses.decoded: From Gad, Eliasaph, the son of Deuel.

verses.kjv: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.decoded: From Naphtali: Ahira, the son of Enan.

verses.kjv: These were the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.
verses.decoded: These were the respected members of the assembly, leaders of their ancestral tribes, and commanders of thousands in Israel.

verses.kjv: And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by their names:
verses.decoded: And these are the names of the men who will stand with you: from the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.

verses.kjv: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.
verses.decoded: And they gathered the entire assembly together on the first day of the second month, and they stated their ancestry according to their families, by their ancestral households, according to the number of individuals, from twenty years old and older, by counting them individually.

verses.kjv: As the Lord commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.decoded: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he counted them in the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.kjv: And the children of Reuben, Israel’s eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.decoded: And the descendants of Reuben, Israel's eldest son, according to their lineage, by their families, by their ancestral households, according to the count of individuals, by their head count, every male twenty years old and older, all who were able to go to war;

verses.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Reuben, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.
verses.decoded: Those who were counted among them, specifically from the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

verses.decoded: From the tribe of Gad, those who were counted among them, according to their families and their ancestral households, by the registration of their names, from twenty years old and above, all who were able to go out to war;

verses.decoded: Those counted among them, specifically from the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand five hundred.

verses.kjv: Of the children of Manasseh, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.decoded: From the descendants of Manasseh, by their family lines, according to their clans, by their ancestral households, according to the count of the names, from twenty years old and above, all who were able to go out to war,

verses.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
verses.decoded: Those who were counted among them, specifically from the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

verses.kjv: Of the children of Benjamin, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.decoded: Regarding the descendants of Benjamin, according to their lineage, by their families, by their ancestral households, based on the count of individuals, from twenty years old and older, all who were able to go out to war;

verses.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
verses.decoded: Those counted among them, specifically from the tribe of Benjamin, totaled thirty-five thousand four hundred.

verses.kjv: Of the children of Dan, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.decoded: From the descendants of Dan, according to their lineages, by their clans, by their ancestral households, based on the count of individuals aged twenty years and older, everyone who was capable of going out to war;

verses.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Dan, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
verses.decoded: Those who were counted among them, specifically from the tribe of Dan, totaled sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

verses.kjv: Of the children of Asher, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.decoded: From the descendants of Asher, by their lineages, according to their families, by their ancestral households, according to the count of individuals, from twenty years old and above, all who were able to go out to war;

verses.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Asher, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
verses.decoded: Those who were counted among them, from the tribe of Asher, totaled forty-one thousand five hundred.

verses.kjv: Of the children of Naphtali, throughout their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.decoded: From the descendants of Naphtali, throughout their family lines, according to their families, by their ancestral households, according to the count of individuals, from twenty years old and above, all who were able to go out to war.

verses.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.decoded: Those who were counted among them, specifically from the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

verses.kjv: These are those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.
verses.decoded: These are the ones who were counted, whom Moses and Aaron counted, along with the leaders of Israel, who were twelve men; each one was from his ancestral household.

verses.kjv: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;
verses.decoded: Thus, all those who were counted among the descendants of Israel, according to their ancestral households, from twenty years old and older, all who were capable of going to war.

verses.kjv: Even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
verses.decoded: All those who were counted totaled six hundred three thousand five hundred and fifty.

verses.kjv: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.
verses.decoded: But the Levites, according to the tribe of their ancestors, were not counted among them.

verses.kjv: For the Lord had spoken unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: For the LORD had spoken to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:
verses.decoded: You must not count the tribe of Levi, nor include them in the census of the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that belong to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.
verses.decoded: But you shall appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all its vessels, and over all things that belong to it: they shall carry the tabernacle, and all its vessels; and they shall serve it, and shall camp around the tabernacle.

verses.kjv: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.decoded: And when the tabernacle moves forward, the Levites must take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites must set it up. And any unauthorized person who comes near must be put to death.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts.
verses.decoded: And the children of Israel will set up their tents, each man by his own camp, and each man by his own standard, throughout their armies.

verses.kjv: But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.decoded: However, the Levites must set up their camps around the tent of the covenant, so that no anger comes upon the assembly of the people of Israel. And the Levites must be responsible for the tent of the covenant.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so did they.
verses.decoded: And the Israelites acted in accordance with everything that the Lord commanded Moses, and they did so.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

verses.kjv: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father’s house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.
verses.decoded: Every man among the Israelites will set up his camp by his own banner, with the flag of their ancestral house, at a distance around the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah pitch throughout their armies: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shall be captain of the children of Judah.
verses.decoded: And on the east side, facing the sunrise, the standard of the camp of Judah shall encamp with their armies. Nahshon, the son of Amminadab, will be the leader of the descendants of Judah.

verses.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
verses.decoded: And his army, and those who were counted among them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

verses.kjv: And those that do pitch next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar shall be captain of the children of Issachar.
verses.decoded: And those who camp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar, and Nethaneel the son of Zuar shall be commander of the descendants of Issachar.

verses.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
verses.decoded: And his army, and those who were counted from it, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

verses.kjv: Then the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon shall be captain of the children of Zebulun.
verses.decoded: Then the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon will be the captain of the descendants of Zebulun.

verses.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
verses.decoded: And those who were counted from the tribe of Zebulun were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

verses.kjv: All that were numbered in the camp of Judah were an hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, throughout their armies. These shall first set forth.
verses.decoded: All who were counted in the camp of Judah were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred. These are the ones who will march out in the first division.

verses.kjv: On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their armies: and the captain of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.decoded: On the south side will be the banner of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions: and the leader of the descendants of Reuben will be Elizur.

verses.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.
verses.decoded: And his army, including those who were counted, totaled forty-six thousand five hundred.

verses.kjv: And those which pitch by him shall be the tribe of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.decoded: And those who camp next to him will be the tribe of Simeon; and the leader of the descendants of Simeon will be Shelumiel, the son of Zurishaddai.

verses.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
verses.decoded: And his army, including those who were counted from them, totaled fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

verses.kjv: Then the tribe of Gad: and the captain of the sons of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
verses.decoded: Then the tribe of Gad; and the leader of the descendants of Gad will be Eliasaph, the son of Reuel.

verses.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.
verses.decoded: And his army, and those who were counted from them, were forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.

verses.kjv: All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben were an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies. And they shall set forth in the second rank.
verses.decoded: All who were counted in the camp of Reuben were one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty, throughout their divisions.

verses.kjv: Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall set forward with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place by their standards.
verses.decoded: Then the Tent of Meeting will move forward with the camp of the Levites in the middle of the camp: as they set up camp, so they will move forward, each person in their designated place, by their banners.

verses.kjv: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their armies: and the captain of the sons of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.decoded: On the west side will be the banner of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions: and the leader of the descendants of Ephraim will be Elishama the son of Ammihud.

verses.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty thousand and five hundred.
verses.decoded: And his company, along with those who were counted among them, totaled forty-one thousand five hundred.

verses.kjv: And by him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the captain of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.decoded: And next to him will be the tribe of Manasseh, and the captain of the children of Manasseh will be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

verses.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
verses.decoded: And his army, and those who were counted among them, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

verses.kjv: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.decoded: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin will be Abidan the son of Gideoni.

verses.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
verses.decoded: And his army, and those who were counted from them, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

verses.kjv: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.
verses.decoded: All who were counted from the camp of Ephraim totaled one hundred eight thousand one hundred, throughout their armies. And they will advance as the third group.

verses.kjv: The standard of the camp of Dan shall be on the north side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.decoded: The banner of the camp of Dan will be on the north side with their divisions; and the leader of the descendants of Dan will be Ahiezer, the son of Ammishaddai.

verses.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
verses.decoded: And his army, and those who were counted among them, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

verses.kjv: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.decoded: And those who camp beside him will be the tribe of Asher; and the leader of the children of Asher will be Pagiel, the son of Ocran.

verses.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
verses.decoded: And his division, and those who were counted among them, were forty-one thousand five hundred.

verses.kjv: Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.decoded: Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the descendants of Naphtali will be Ahira, the son of Enan.

verses.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.decoded: And his army, and those who were counted among them, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

verses.kjv: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan were an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.
verses.decoded: All those who were counted in the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They will go last with their standards.

verses.kjv: These are those which were numbered of the children of Israel by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
verses.decoded: These are the ones who were counted from the descendants of Israel, according to their ancestral houses. All those who were counted from the camps throughout their armies totaled six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

verses.kjv: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: But the Levites were not counted among the descendants of Israel, just as the Lord instructed Moses.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.
verses.decoded: The Israelites did everything the Lord commanded Moses. They camped by their banners, and then they moved forward, each one.

verses.kjv: These also are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the Lord spake with Moses in mount Sinai.
verses.decoded: These are also the records of Aaron and Moses on the day that the LORD spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.

verses.kjv: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.decoded: And these are the names of Aaron's sons: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.kjv: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests which were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.
verses.decoded: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests who were anointed, whom he dedicated to serve as priests.

verses.kjv: And Nadab and Abihu died before the Lord, when they offered strange fire before the Lord, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the sight of Aaron their father.
verses.decoded: Nadab and Abihu died in the presence of the Lord when they offered unauthorized fire before the Lord in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children. Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests in the presence of Aaron their father.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.
verses.decoded: Bring the tribe of Levi close, and present them before Aaron the priest, so that they may serve him.

verses.kjv: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.decoded: And they will be responsible for his duty, and the duty of the entire assembly in front of the tent of meeting, to perform the work of the tent.

verses.kjv: And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.decoded: And they are to take care of all the articles of the tabernacle of meeting, and the duties of the Israelites, to perform the service of the tabernacle.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him out of the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: And you shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons; they are entirely given to him from the children of Israel.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest’s office: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.decoded: And you shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall perform their priestly duties; and any unauthorized person who approaches shall be put to death.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn that openeth the matrix among the children of Israel: therefore the Levites shall be mine;
verses.decoded: And indeed, I have taken the Levites from among the Israelites instead of all the firstborn who are born among the Israelites; therefore the Levites will be mine.

verses.kjv: Because all the firstborn are mine; for on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I am the Lord.
verses.decoded: Because all the firstborn are mine; for on the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I set apart for myself all the firstborn in Israel, both humans and animals: they shall be mine: I am the Lord.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

verses.kjv: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.
verses.decoded: Count the descendants of Levi according to their fathers' households, by their families: you shall count every male from one month old and older.

verses.kjv: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the Lord, as he was commanded.
verses.decoded: And Moses counted them according to the word of the Lord, just as he was commanded.

verses.kjv: And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.
verses.decoded: These were the sons of Levi, listed by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.kjv: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.
verses.decoded: And these are the names of Gershon's sons according to their families: Libni and Shimi.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.decoded: The sons of Kohath, listed by their family groups, were Amram, Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.
verses.decoded: The sons of Merari, according to their families, were Libni and Shimi. These are the families of the Merarites.

verses.kjv: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these are the families of the Gershonites.
verses.decoded: From Gershon came the family of the Libnites and the family of the Shimites; these are the families of the Gershonites.

verses.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.
verses.decoded: Those who were counted among them, according to the count of all the males, from one month old and older, even those who were counted among them were seven thousand five hundred.

verses.kjv: The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.
verses.decoded: The families of the Gershonites were to set up camp behind the tabernacle westward.

verses.kjv: And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.
verses.decoded: And the leader of the ancestral house of the Gershonites will be Eliasaph, the son of Lael.

verses.kjv: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.decoded: The responsibility of the descendants of Gershon in the tent of meeting will be the tent itself, and its covering, and the curtain for the entrance of the tent of meeting,

verses.kjv: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.
verses.decoded: And the curtains of the courtyard, and the curtain for the entrance of the courtyard, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar all around, and its ropes for all its service.

verses.kjv: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.
verses.decoded: The family of the Kohathites came from Kohath. From them came the family of the Amramites, the family of the Izeharites, the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites. These are the families of the Kohathites.

verses.kjv: In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.decoded: The total number of all the males, from one month old and older, was eight thousand six hundred, who were responsible for the duties of the sanctuary.

verses.kjv: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.
verses.decoded: The families of Kohath's descendants were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle.

verses.kjv: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
verses.decoded: And the leader of the families of the Kohathites was Elizaphan, the son of Uzziel.

verses.kjv: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.
verses.decoded: And their responsibility will be the ark, and the table, and the lampstand, and the altars, and the utensils of the sanctuary with which they serve, and the curtain.

verses.kjv: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be chief over the chief of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.decoded: And Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, will be the chief over the leaders of the Levites, and will oversee those who are responsible for the sanctuary.

verses.kjv: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.
verses.decoded: The family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites belonged to Merari; these are the families of Merari.

verses.kjv: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.
verses.decoded: And those who were counted among them, according to the count of all the males, from one month old and older, were six thousand two hundred.

verses.kjv: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: these shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.
verses.decoded: The leader of the ancestral house of the Merarite families was Zuriel, the son of Abihail; they will set up their camp on the north side of the tabernacle.

verses.kjv: And under the custody and charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serveth thereto,
verses.decoded: The responsibility of the descendants of Merari included the planks of the tabernacle, its bars, its pillars, its bases, all its utensils, and everything used in its service.

verses.kjv: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.
verses.decoded: And the pillars of the surrounding courtyard, with their bases, their pegs, and their ropes.

verses.kjv: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, even before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.decoded: But those who camp in front of the tabernacle to the east, specifically in front of the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, will be Moses, Aaron, and his sons, responsible for the sanctuary on behalf of the Israelites; and any unauthorized person who approaches will be put to death.

verses.kjv: All that were numbered of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the Lord, throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.
verses.decoded: All of the Levites who were counted, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the command of the LORD, throughout their families, all the males a month old and older, totaled twenty-two thousand.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
verses.decoded: And the Lord said to Moses, Count all the firstborn males of the Israelites who are a month old or older, and record their names.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am the Lord) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: And you shall take the Levites for me (I am the LORD) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the cattle of the children of Israel.

verses.kjv: And Moses numbered, as the Lord commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: And Moses counted, as the Lord instructed him, all the firstborn among the descendants of Israel.

verses.kjv: And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.
verses.decoded: And all the firstborn males, counted by name, from one month old and older, among those who were registered, totaled twenty-two thousand two hundred and seventy-three.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am the Lord.
verses.decoded: Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of their livestock; and the Levites will be mine.

verses.kjv: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the firstborn of the children of Israel, which are more than the Levites;
verses.decoded: And for those who are to be redeemed of the two hundred and seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel, who are more than the Levites:

verses.kjv: Thou shalt even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them: (the shekel is twenty gerahs:)
verses.decoded: You shall take five shekels per person; you shall take them according to the sanctuary shekel (the shekel is twenty gerahs).

verses.kjv: And thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is to be redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.
verses.decoded: And you shall give the money, with which the surplus number of them is to be redeemed, to Aaron and to his sons.

verses.kjv: And Moses took the redemption money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites:
verses.decoded: And Moses took the redemption money from those who were in excess of the number redeemed by the Levites.

verses.kjv: Of the firstborn of the children of Israel took he the money; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.decoded: From the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money; one thousand three hundred and sixty-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

verses.kjv: And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the Lord, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: And Moses gave the money of those who were redeemed to Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the Lord, as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

verses.kjv: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,
verses.decoded: Count the descendants of Kohath from among the descendants of Levi, according to their families, by their ancestral households.

verses.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.decoded: From thirty years old and older, up to fifty years old, all who are eligible for service, to perform duties in the Tent of Meeting.

verses.kjv: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, about the most holy things:
verses.decoded: This will be the work of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, regarding the most holy things.

verses.kjv: And when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering vail, and cover the ark of testimony with it:
verses.decoded: And when the camp moves forward, Aaron and his sons shall come, and they shall take down the covering veil, and cover the ark of testimony with it.

verses.kjv: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers’ skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.
verses.decoded: And they shall place on it the covering of badger skins, and they shall spread over it an entirely blue cloth, and they shall insert its poles.

verses.kjv: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:
verses.decoded: And on the table of showbread, they are to spread a blue cloth, and place on it the dishes, the spoons, the bowls, and the covers for covering; and the regular bread must remain on it.

verses.kjv: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.
verses.decoded: And they will spread over them a scarlet cloth, and cover it with a covering of badger skins, and insert its poles.

verses.kjv: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:
verses.decoded: And they are to take a blue cloth, and cover the lampstand, its lamps, its tongs, its snuff dishes, and all its oil containers.

verses.kjv: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put it upon a bar.
verses.decoded: And they will place it and all its utensils inside a covering of badger skins, and they will place it on a carrying pole.

verses.kjv: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put to the staves thereof:
verses.decoded: And on the golden altar they will spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of badger skins, and will attach its poles.

verses.kjv: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put them on a bar:
verses.decoded: And they are to take all the instruments of ministry, with which they serve in the sanctuary, and place them in a blue cloth, and cover them with a covering of badger skins, and place them on a carrying pole.

verses.kjv: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:
verses.decoded: And they will remove the ashes from the altar and spread a purple cloth over it.

verses.kjv: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, even the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basons, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers’ skins, and put to the staves of it.
verses.decoded: And on the altar they shall place all its utensils, which are used for service at it, namely, the censers, the meat forks, the shovels, and the bowls, all the utensils of the altar; and they shall spread over it a covering of badger skins, and attach its carrying poles.

verses.kjv: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.decoded: And when Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is ready to move forward, after that, the sons of Kohath will come to carry it. But they must not touch any holy object, so that they do not die. These things are the responsibilities of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting.

verses.kjv: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.
verses.decoded: And the responsibility of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, includes the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the daily grain offering, the anointing oil, and the supervision of the entire tabernacle, and of everything within it, in the sanctuary, and in its vessels.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

verses.kjv: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:
verses.decoded: You must not cut off the tribal clans of the Kohathites from among the Levites.

verses.kjv: But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:
verses.decoded: But do this for them, so that they may live and not die when they approach the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in and assign each one to his service and his responsibility.

verses.kjv: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.
verses.decoded: However, they are not to go in to look at the holy objects while they are being covered, otherwise they will die.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;
verses.decoded: Also take a count of the sons of Gershon, according to their fathers' households, by their families.

verses.kjv: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.decoded: From thirty years old and older, up to fifty years old, you shall count them; all who come to perform the service, to do the work in the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:
verses.decoded: This is the duty of the families of the Gershonites, to perform service and to carry loads.

verses.kjv: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers’ skins that is above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.decoded: And they will carry the curtains of the tabernacle, and the covering of the tent of meeting, and the covering made of badger skins that is on top of it, and the curtain for the entrance of the courtyard gate, and its ropes, and all the equipment for their service, and whatever is made for them.

verses.kjv: And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.
verses.decoded: And the curtains of the courtyard, and the curtain for the entrance of the gate of the courtyard, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar all around, and their ropes, and all the equipment for their service, and whatever is made for them, these they shall carry, and they shall be responsible for all their service.

verses.kjv: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.
verses.decoded: Under the direction of Aaron and his sons, all the duties of the Gershonites will be, concerning all their loads and all their work; and you shall assign to them all their responsibilities.

verses.kjv: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.decoded: These are the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tent of meeting, under the direction of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

verses.kjv: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;
verses.decoded: Regarding the sons of Merari, you are to count them by their families, by their fathers' households.

verses.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.decoded: And by their families, by their ancestral households, according to the number of individuals, from twenty years old and older, even everyone who enters into the service, for the work in the tent of meeting;

verses.kjv: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,
verses.decoded: And their responsibility will be the planks of the tabernacle, and its bars, and its posts, and its bases,

verses.kjv: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.
verses.decoded: And the pillars around the courtyard, along with their bases, their pegs, their ropes, all their equipment, and all their service.

verses.kjv: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.decoded: This is the duty of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their duties, in the tent of meeting, under the authority of Ithamar the son of Aaron.

verses.kjv: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
verses.decoded: Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of the community counted the descendants of Kohath according to their families and their ancestral households.

verses.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.decoded: From thirty years old and older, up to fifty years old, everyone who enters into the service for the work in the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
verses.decoded: And those who were counted among them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.

verses.kjv: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
verses.decoded: These were the ones who were counted from the families of the Kohathites, all who could perform service in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the command of the LORD through Moses.

verses.kjv: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers,
verses.decoded: And those who were counted from the descendants of Gershon, throughout their families, and according to their fathers' houses,

verses.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.decoded: From thirty years old and older, up to fifty years old, everyone who enters into the service, for the work in the tent of meeting,

verses.kjv: Even those that were numbered of them, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.
verses.decoded: Even those who were counted among them, throughout their families, according to their ancestral households, totaled two thousand six hundred and thirty.

verses.kjv: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the Lord.
verses.decoded: These are the ones who were counted from the families of the sons of Gershon, all who could perform service in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the command of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers,
verses.decoded: And those who were counted from the families of the sons of Merari, throughout their families, according to their fathers' households,

verses.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.decoded: From thirty years old and older, up to fifty years old, everyone who enters into the service for the work in the meeting tent.

verses.kjv: Even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.
verses.decoded: Those who were counted among them, according to their families, were three thousand two hundred.

verses.kjv: These be those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
verses.decoded: These are the ones who were counted from the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the word of the LORD through Moses.

verses.kjv: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
verses.decoded: All those who were counted among the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the leaders of Israel counted, according to their families, and according to their ancestral households.

verses.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.decoded: Everyone from thirty years old and older, up to fifty years old, who came to perform the service of the ministry and the service of carrying burdens in the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.kjv: Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore.
verses.decoded: Even those who were counted among them were eight thousand five hundred and eighty.

verses.kjv: According to the commandment of the Lord they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: Following the LORD's command, Moses counted them, each one according to their service and their responsibility; in this way, they were counted by him, just as the LORD had commanded.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is defiled by the dead:
verses.decoded: Command the Israelites to remove from the camp every person with a skin disease, and everyone who has a bodily discharge, and whoever has become unclean by touching a dead body:

verses.kjv: Both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst whereof I dwell.
verses.decoded: Both male and female you shall put out; you shall put them outside the camp, so that they do not defile their camps, where I dwell.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp: as the Lord spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: And the Israelites did so, and put them outside the camp; as the Lord spoke to Moses, so the Israelites did.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the Lord, and that person be guilty;
verses.decoded: Speak to the people of Israel: When a man or woman commits any sin that people commit, acting unfaithfully against the Lord, and that person is guilty.

verses.kjv: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he hath trespassed.
verses.decoded: Then they must confess the sin they have committed: and he must repay his offense with the full amount, and add a fifth of its value to it, and give it to the one against whom he has offended.

verses.kjv: But if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, let the trespass be recompensed unto the Lord, even to the priest; beside the ram of the atonement, whereby an atonement shall be made for him.
verses.decoded: But if the man has no relative to whom he can make restitution for the offense, then the restitution for the offense must be made to the Lord, specifically to the priest, in addition to the ram of atonement, by which atonement will be made for him.

verses.kjv: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring unto the priest, shall be his.
verses.decoded: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring to the priest, will be his.

verses.kjv: And every man’s hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.
verses.decoded: And every man's sacred things will belong to him: whatever any man gives the priest, it will belong to him.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man’s wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,
verses.decoded: Speak to the children of Israel and say to them, If any man's wife goes astray and commits an offense against him,

verses.kjv: And a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, neither she be taken with the manner;
verses.decoded: And a man has sexual intercourse with her, and it is hidden from her husband's sight, and kept secret, and she becomes defiled, and there is no witness against her,

verses.kjv: And the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:
verses.decoded: And if the spirit of jealousy comes upon him, and he becomes jealous of his wife, and she is defiled; or if the spirit of jealousy comes upon him, and he becomes jealous of his wife, and she is not defiled:

verses.kjv: Then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.
verses.decoded: Then the man will bring his wife to the priest, and he will bring her offering for her, one-tenth of an ephah of barley flour; he must not pour oil on it, nor put frankincense on it; because it is an offering of jealousy, an offering of remembrance, recalling wrongdoing.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the Lord:
verses.decoded: And the priest will bring her close, and present her before the Lord:

verses.kjv: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water:
verses.decoded: And the priest is to take holy water in a clay pot; and the priest is to take some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle, and put it into the water.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall set the woman before the Lord, and uncover the woman’s head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which is the jealousy offering: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causeth the curse:
verses.decoded: And the priest will place the woman before the Lord, and uncover the woman's head, and put the memorial offering in her hands, which is the jealousy offering.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness with another instead of thy husband, be thou free from this bitter water that causeth the curse:
verses.decoded: And the priest will make her swear an oath, and say to the woman, If no man has had sexual relations with you, and if you have not turned aside to impurity with another man instead of your husband, be free from this bitter water that brings the curse.

verses.kjv: But if thou hast gone aside to another instead of thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee beside thine husband:
verses.decoded: But if you have gone to another instead of your husband, and if you are defiled, and some man has slept with you besides your husband:

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, The Lord make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the Lord doth make thy thigh to rot, and thy belly to swell;
verses.decoded: Then the priest will make the woman take an oath that brings a curse, and the priest will say to the woman, 'May the Lord make you a curse and an oath among your people, when the Lord causes your thigh to waste away and your abdomen to swell;'

verses.kjv: And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make thy belly to swell, and thy thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.
verses.decoded: And this water that causes the curse will go into your intestines, to make your abdomen swell, and your thigh waste away: And the woman will say, Amen, amen.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out with the bitter water:
verses.decoded: And the priest will write these curses in a book, and he will wash them off with the bitter water.

verses.kjv: And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter.
verses.decoded: And he will make the woman drink the bitter water that brings the curse; and the water that brings the curse will enter her and become bitter.

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the offering before the Lord, and offer it upon the altar:
verses.decoded: Then the priest will take the jealousy offering from the woman's hand, and will wave the offering before the Lord, and offer it on the altar.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall take an handful of the offering, even the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.
verses.decoded: And the priest will take a handful of the offering, as its memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, and then he will make the woman drink the water.

verses.kjv: And when he hath made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, that, if she be defiled, and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall rot: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.
verses.decoded: And when he has made her drink the water, then it will happen that if she is defiled and has been unfaithful to her husband, then.

verses.kjv: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.
verses.decoded: And if the woman is not defiled, but is clean, then she will be free and will conceive children.

verses.kjv: This is the law of jealousies, when a wife goeth aside to another instead of her husband, and is defiled;
verses.decoded: This is the law concerning jealousy, when a wife goes astray with another man instead of her husband, and becomes defiled;

verses.kjv: Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the Lord, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.
verses.decoded: As when the spirit of jealousy comes upon him, and he becomes jealous of his wife, and presents the woman before the LORD, and the priest will carry out all these laws concerning her.

verses.kjv: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.
verses.decoded: Then the man will be innocent of wrongdoing, and this woman will bear her wrongdoing.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When either man or woman shall separate themselves to vow a vow of a Nazarite, to separate themselves unto the Lord:
verses.decoded: Speak to the children of Israel and say to them, 'When either a man or a woman sets themselves apart by making a Nazirite vow, to dedicate themselves to the LORD:'

verses.kjv: He shall separate himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.
verses.decoded: He must abstain from wine and alcoholic beverages, and must not drink any vinegar made from wine or alcoholic beverages, nor drink any grape juice, or eat fresh or dried grapes.

verses.kjv: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.
verses.decoded: Throughout the period of his dedication to the LORD, he must not eat anything that comes from the grapevine, from the seeds to the skin.

verses.kjv: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no rasor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth himself unto the Lord, he shall be holy, and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.
verses.decoded: Throughout the entire period of his vow of dedication, no razor shall touch his head. Until the days are completed, during which he dedicated himself to the LORD, he shall be consecrated, and he must let the hair of his head grow long.

verses.kjv: All the days that he separateth himself unto the Lord he shall come at no dead body.
verses.decoded: All the days that he dedicates himself to the LORD, he must not go near a dead body.

verses.kjv: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God is upon his head.
verses.decoded: He must not shave his head bald, nor trim the edges of his beard, nor make any cuts on his body.

verses.kjv: All the days of his separation he is holy unto the Lord.
verses.decoded: All the days of his separation he is holy to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.
verses.decoded: And if anyone dies very suddenly near him, and he has defiled his consecrated head, then he must shave his head on the day of his purification; on the seventh day he must shave it.

verses.kjv: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.decoded: On the eighth day he must bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.
verses.decoded: And the priest will offer one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering, and make atonement for him, because he became defiled by a dead body, and will consecrate his head that same day.

verses.kjv: And he shall consecrate unto the Lord the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a trespass offering: but the days that were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.
verses.decoded: And he shall dedicate to the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb in its first year as a trespass offering; but the previous days shall be forfeited, because his separation was defiled.

verses.kjv: And this is the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.decoded: And this is the law for the Nazirite when the days of his separation are completed: he shall be brought to the entrance of the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And he shall offer his offering unto the Lord, one he lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for peace offerings,
verses.decoded: And he will present his offering to the LORD, one male lamb a year old without defect for a burnt offering, and one female lamb a year old without defect for a sin offering, and one ram two years old without defect for peace offerings.

verses.kjv: And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings.
verses.decoded: And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes made of fine flour mixed with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread spread with oil, along with their grain offering and their drink offerings.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall bring them before the Lord, and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering:
verses.decoded: And the priest will bring them before the Lord, and will offer his sin offering and his burnt offering.

verses.kjv: And he shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the Lord, with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.decoded: And he will offer the ram as a peace offering sacrifice to the LORD, along with the basket of unleavened bread: his grain offering also, and his drink offering.

verses.kjv: And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it in the fire which is under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.
verses.decoded: Then the Nazirite must shave his consecrated head at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, and take the hair from his consecrated head and put it on the fire that is beneath the sacrifice of the peace offerings.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall take the sodden shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazarite, after the hair of his separation is shaven:
verses.decoded: Then the priest will take the boiled shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake from the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and will place them on the hands of the Nazirite, after he has shaved the head of his dedication.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the Lord: this is holy for the priest, with the wave breast and heave shoulder: and after that the Nazarite may drink wine.
verses.decoded: And the priest will wave them as a wave offering before the Lord; this is sacred for the priest, along with the waved breast and the raised shoulder: and after this the Nazirite may drink wine.

verses.kjv: This is the law of the Nazarite who hath vowed, and of his offering unto the Lord for his separation, beside that that his hand shall get: according to the vow which he vowed, so he must do after the law of his separation.
verses.decoded: This is the law for the Nazarite who has made a vow, and for his offering to the Lord for his consecration, in addition to what he can provide. He must act according to the vow he made, following the law of his consecration.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying, On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel, saying unto them,
verses.decoded: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, In this manner you shall bless the children of Israel, saying to them,

verses.kjv: The Lord bless thee, and keep thee:
verses.decoded: The LORD bless you and keep you:

verses.kjv: The Lord make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:
verses.decoded: The LORD make his face shine upon you, and be gracious to you.

verses.kjv: The Lord lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
verses.decoded: The LORD lift up his face upon you, and give you peace.

verses.kjv: And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel; and I will bless them.
verses.decoded: And they will place my name on the descendants of Israel; and I will bless them.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all the instruments thereof, both the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;
verses.decoded: On the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and consecrated it, and all its instruments,

verses.kjv: That the princes of Israel, heads of the house of their fathers, who were the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:
verses.decoded: The leaders of Israel, the heads of their ancestral households, who were the leaders of the tribes and were in charge of those who had been counted, presented their offerings.

verses.kjv: And they brought their offering before the Lord, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they brought them before the tabernacle.
verses.decoded: And they brought their offering before the LORD, six covered wagons and twelve oxen; one wagon for every two of the leaders, and one ox for each leader.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Take it of them, that they may be to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, to every man according to his service.
verses.decoded: Accept these from them, so that they may perform the service of the Tent of Meeting; and you shall give them to the Levites, to each man according to his service.

verses.kjv: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.
verses.decoded: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them to the Levites.

verses.kjv: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:
verses.decoded: He gave two wagons and four oxen to the sons of Gershon, according to their service.

verses.kjv: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.decoded: He gave four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the supervision of Ithamar, Aaron the priest's son.

verses.kjv: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonging unto them was that they should bear upon their shoulders.
verses.decoded: But to the sons of Kohath he gave none, because the service of the sanctuary belonging to them was that they should carry upon their shoulders.

verses.kjv: And the princes offered for dedicating of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their offering before the altar.
verses.decoded: And the leaders presented offerings for the dedication of the altar on the day it was anointed; indeed, the leaders presented their offering before the altar.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to Moses, They are to present their offering, each leader on his day, for the dedication of the altar.

verses.kjv: And he that offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:
verses.decoded: The one who presented his offering on the first day was Nahshon, son of Amminadab, from the tribe of Judah.

verses.kjv: And his offering was one silver charger, the weight thereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them were full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
verses.decoded: His offering was one silver plate, weighing one hundred and thirty shekels, and one silver bowl weighing seventy shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel; both of them were filled with fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering.

verses.kjv: One spoon of ten shekels of gold, full of incense:
verses.decoded: One dish weighing ten shekels of gold, full of incense:

verses.kjv: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.decoded: One young bull, one ram, one lamb a year old, for a burnt offering.

verses.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.decoded: One young goat as a sin offering.

verses.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.decoded: And for the peace offering sacrifice, there were two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five one-year-old lambs. This was the offering of Nahshon, the son of Amminadab.

verses.kjv: On the second day Nethaneel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, did offer:
verses.decoded: On the second day, Nethaneel, the son of Zuar, the leader of Issachar, offered:

verses.kjv: He offered for his offering one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
verses.decoded: He presented as his offering one silver plate, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl weighing seventy shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel; both of them were filled with fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering.

verses.kjv: One spoon of gold of ten shekels, full of incense:
verses.decoded: His offering was one silver plate weighing one hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl weighing seventy shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel standard; both of them filled with fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering.

verses.kjv: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.decoded: One young bull, one ram, one one-year-old lamb for a burnt offering; one young goat for a sin offering; and for a fellowship offering, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five one-year-old lambs. This was the offering of Nethanel, son of Zuar.

verses.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.decoded: One young goat for a sin offering.

verses.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
verses.decoded: And for a peace offering, there were two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five one-year-old lambs. This was the offering from Nethaneel, the son of Zuar.

verses.kjv: On the third day Eliab the son of Helon, prince of the children of Zebulun, did offer:
verses.decoded: On the fourth day, Elizur, the son of Shedeur, leader of the descendants of Reuben, offered:

verses.kjv: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
verses.decoded: His offering was one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel;

verses.kjv: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
verses.decoded: One golden spoon weighing ten shekels, full of incense.

verses.kjv: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
