verses.decoded: And his offering was one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meat offering:

verses.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.decoded: One young goat for a sin offering.

verses.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.decoded: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five one-year-old lambs: this was the offering of Eliab, the son of Helon.

verses.kjv: On the fourth day Elizur the son of Shedeur, prince of the children of Reuben, did offer:
verses.decoded: On the fourth day, Elizur, the son of Shedeur, leader of the descendants of Reuben, offered.

verses.kjv: His offering was one silver charger of the weight of an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
verses.decoded: One young goat for a sin offering.

verses.kjv: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
verses.decoded: One golden spoon weighing ten shekels, full of incense:

verses.kjv: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.decoded: One young goat for a sin offering; and for a peace offering sacrifice, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs a year old: this was the offering of Elizur, the son of Shedeur.

verses.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.decoded: One young goat for a sin offering.

verses.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.decoded: And for a peace offering, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five one-year-old lambs: this was the offering from Elizur, son of Shedeur.

verses.kjv: On the fifth day Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai, prince of the children of Simeon, did offer:
verses.decoded: On the fifth day, Shelumiel, the son of Zurishaddai, who was the leader of the tribe of Simeon, presented his offering.

verses.kjv: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
verses.decoded: His offering was one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl weighing seventy shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering.

verses.kjv: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
verses.decoded: One golden spoon weighing ten shekels, full of incense.

verses.kjv: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.decoded: One young bull, one ram, one one-year-old lamb, for a burnt offering.

verses.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.decoded: One young goat for a sin offering.

verses.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.decoded: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five lambs in their first year: this was the offering of Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

verses.kjv: On the sixth day Eliasaph the son of Deuel, prince of the children of Gad, offered:
verses.decoded: On the sixth day, Eliasaph the son of Deuel, leader of the descendants of Gad, presented an offering.

verses.kjv: His offering was one silver charger of the weight of an hundred and thirty shekels, a silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
verses.decoded: His offering was one silver platter weighing one hundred and thirty shekels, a silver bowl weighing seventy shekels, according to the standard weight of the sanctuary;

verses.kjv: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
verses.decoded: One golden spoon weighing ten shekels, full of incense:

verses.kjv: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.decoded: one young bull, one ram, one lamb in its first year, for a burnt offering.

verses.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.decoded: One young goat as a sin offering.

verses.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
verses.decoded: And for a peace offering, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five one-year-old lambs: this was the offering from Eliasaph, the son of Deuel.

verses.kjv: On the seventh day Elishama the son of Ammihud, prince of the children of Ephraim, offered:
verses.decoded: On the seventh day, Elishama, the son of Ammihud, the leader of the descendants of Ephraim, offered:

verses.kjv: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
verses.decoded: On the ninth day, Abidan, the son of Gideoni, leader of the descendants of Benjamin, made his offering.

verses.kjv: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
verses.decoded: one golden spoon weighing ten shekels, full of incense:

verses.kjv: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.decoded: One young bull, one ram, one lamb in its first year, as a burnt offering.

verses.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.decoded: One young goat as a sin offering.

verses.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.decoded: And for a peace offering sacrifice, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five one-year-old lambs were given. This was the offering from Elishama, the son of Ammihud.

verses.kjv: On the eighth day offered Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur, prince of the children of Manasseh:
verses.decoded: On the eighth day, Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur, the prince of the children of Manasseh, made an offering:

verses.kjv: His offering was one silver charger of the weight of an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
verses.decoded: His offering was one silver plate weighing one hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl weighing seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

verses.kjv: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
verses.decoded: One gold spoon weighing ten shekels, full of incense.

verses.kjv: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.decoded: One young bull, one ram, one lamb a year old, for a burnt offering.

verses.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.decoded: One young goat for a sin offering:

verses.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.decoded: And as a sacrifice for peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five lambs in their first year: this was the offering from Gamaliel, the son of Pedahzur.

verses.kjv: On the ninth day Abidan the son of Gideoni, prince of the children of Benjamin, offered:
verses.decoded: On the ninth day, Abidan, the son of Gideoni, the leader of the tribe of Benjamin, presented an offering.

verses.kjv: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
verses.decoded: His offering was one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl weighing seventy shekels, according to the standard shekel of the sanctuary; both of them filled with fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering.

verses.kjv: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
verses.decoded: All the oxen for the burnt offering were twelve young bulls, sixty rams, sixty male goats, and sixty lambs in their first year. This was the dedication of the altar after it had been anointed.

verses.kjv: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.decoded: One young bull, one ram, one lamb one year old, for a burnt offering.

verses.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.decoded: One young goat for a sin offering:

verses.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.decoded: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five lambs in their first year: this was the offering of Abidan the son of Gideoni.

verses.kjv: On the tenth day Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai, prince of the children of Dan, offered:
verses.decoded: On the tenth day, Ahiezer, the son of Ammishaddai, the leader of the descendants of Dan, made his offering:

verses.kjv: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
verses.decoded: His offering was one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering.

verses.kjv: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
verses.decoded: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense.

verses.kjv: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.decoded: One young bull, one ram, one one-year-old lamb, for a burnt offering.

verses.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.decoded: One young goat as a sin offering.

verses.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.decoded: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahiezer the son of.

verses.kjv: On the eleventh day Pagiel the son of Ocran, prince of the children of Asher, offered:
verses.decoded: On the eleventh day, Pagiel, son of Ocran, leader of the tribe of Asher, presented an offering.

verses.kjv: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
verses.decoded: His offering was one silver platter, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, and one silver bowl weighing seventy shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel; both of them were filled with fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering.

verses.kjv: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
verses.decoded: One golden spoon weighing ten shekels, full of incense.

verses.kjv: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.decoded: One young bull, one ram, one lamb in its first year, for a burnt offering.

verses.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.decoded: One young goat as a sin offering.

verses.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.decoded: And for a peace offering, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five one-year-old lambs: this was the offering of Pagiel the son of Ocran.

verses.kjv: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali, offered:
verses.decoded: On the twelfth day, Ahira, the son of Enan, the leader of the descendants of Naphtali, offered:

verses.kjv: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
verses.decoded: His offering was one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.

verses.kjv: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
verses.decoded: One golden spoon weighing ten shekels, full of incense.

verses.kjv: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.decoded: One young bull, one ram, one lamb a year old, for a burnt offering.

verses.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.decoded: One young goat as a sin offering.

verses.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.decoded: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five one-year-old lambs: this was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.

verses.kjv: This was the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve chargers of silver, twelve silver bowls, twelve spoons of gold:
verses.decoded: This was the dedication of the altar on the day it was anointed by the leaders of Israel: twelve silver plates, twelve silver bowls, and twelve gold dishes,

verses.kjv: Each charger of silver weighing an hundred and thirty shekels, each bowl seventy: all the silver vessels weighed two thousand and four hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.decoded: All the silver vessels weighed two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel; the total weight of all their vessels was two thousand four hundred shekels.

verses.kjv: The golden spoons were twelve, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the spoons was an hundred and twenty shekels.
verses.decoded: There were twelve golden dishes, each filled with incense, and each weighing ten shekels, according to the standard shekel of the sanctuary. The total weight of the gold from all the dishes was one hundred and twenty shekels.

verses.kjv: All the oxen for the burnt offering were twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the lambs of the first year twelve, with their meat offering: and the kids of the goats for sin offering twelve.
verses.decoded: All the cattle for the burnt offering were twelve young bulls, twelve rams, twelve lambs in their first year, along with their grain offering, and twelve young goats.

verses.kjv: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings were twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after that it was anointed.
verses.decoded: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings were twenty-four young bulls, the rams sixty, the male goats sixty, and the lambs of the first year sixty.

verses.kjv: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.
verses.decoded: And when Moses went into the tent of meeting to speak with him, then he heard the voice of someone speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the covenant, from between the two cherubim; and he spoke to him.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.
verses.decoded: Speak to Aaron and say to him, When you light the lamps, the seven lamps will give light in front of the lampstand.

verses.kjv: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: And Aaron did so; he lit its lamps in front of the lampstand, just as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And this work of the candlestick was of beaten gold, unto the shaft thereof, unto the flowers thereof, was beaten work: according unto the pattern which the Lord had shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.
verses.decoded: This is how the lampstand was made: it was hammered out of pure gold, from its base to its flowers. It was made exactly according to the design that the Lord had shown Moses.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
verses.decoded: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

verses.kjv: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.
verses.decoded: And this is what you must do to them to cleanse them: Sprinkle purifying water on them, and have them shave their entire body, and have them wash their clothes, and in this way they will become clean.

verses.kjv: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering, even fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.
verses.decoded: Then they are to take a young bull with its grain offering, specifically fine flour mixed with oil, and you are to take another young bull for a sin offering.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together:
verses.decoded: And you shall bring the Levites before the Tent of Meeting, and you shall gather the entire assembly of the children of Israel.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the Lord: and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:
verses.decoded: And you are to bring the Levites before the LORD: and the children of Israel are to place their hands on the Levites:

verses.kjv: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the Lord for an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the Lord.
verses.decoded: And Aaron will present the Levites before the Lord as an offering from the people of Israel, so that they may perform the service of the Lord.

verses.kjv: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, unto the Lord, to make an atonement for the Levites.
verses.decoded: And the Levites will lay their hands on the heads of the young bulls: and you will offer one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, to the LORD, to make atonement for the Levites.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for an offering unto the Lord.
verses.decoded: And you shall place the Levites before Aaron and before his sons, and present them as an offering to the Lord.

verses.kjv: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.
verses.decoded: In this way, you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites will be mine.

verses.kjv: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for an offering.
verses.decoded: After that, the Levites will go in to perform the service of the Tent of Meeting, and you shall cleanse them and present them as an offering.

verses.kjv: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, even instead of the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.
verses.decoded: For they are completely given to me from among the people of Israel; instead of those who are the firstborn of every mother, even instead of the firstborn of all the people of Israel, I have taken them for myself.

verses.kjv: For all the firstborn of the children of Israel are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.
verses.decoded: Because all the firstborn among the Israelites belong to me, both human and animal. On the day I struck down every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I set them apart for myself.

verses.kjv: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: And I have taken the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

verses.kjv: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.
verses.decoded: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the Israelites, to perform the service for the Israelites in the Tent of Meeting, and to make atonement for the Israelites, so that no plague may occur among the Israelites when they approach the sanctuary.

verses.kjv: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according unto all that the Lord commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.
verses.decoded: And Moses, Aaron, and the entire assembly of the Israelites did to the Levites everything that the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them as an offering before the Lord; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.
verses.decoded: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron presented them as an offering before the Lord; and Aaron performed a ritual of atonement for them to cleanse them.

verses.kjv: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the Lord had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.
verses.decoded: After that, the Levites went in to perform their service in the Tent of Meeting before Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: This is it that belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.decoded: This is what belongs to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and older they shall enter to perform service in the Tent of Meeting.

verses.kjv: And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service thereof, and shall serve no more:
verses.decoded: And from the age of fifty years they shall stop performing the service of it, and shall serve no more.

verses.kjv: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charge.
verses.decoded: But they shall serve with their fellow Levites in the Tent of Meeting, to oversee the responsibilities, and shall not perform any heavy labor. This is what you shall do for the Levites regarding their duties.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

verses.kjv: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at his appointed season.
verses.decoded: The children of Israel must also observe the Passover at its appointed time.

verses.kjv: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, ye shall keep it in his appointed season: according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies thereof, shall ye keep it.
verses.decoded: On the fourteenth day of this month, in the evening, you shall observe it at its appointed time, according to all its rituals and according to all its ceremonies.

verses.kjv: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.
verses.decoded: And Moses spoke to the children of Israel, that they should keep the Passover.

verses.kjv: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at even in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: And they observed the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month in the evening in the Wilderness of Sinai, exactly as the LORD had commanded Moses, the children of Israel did so.

verses.kjv: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:
verses.decoded: There were some men who had become unclean because of a dead human body, so they could not observe the Passover on that day, and they came before Moses.

verses.kjv: And those men said unto him, We are defiled by the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the Lord in his appointed season among the children of Israel?
verses.decoded: And those men said to him, We are defiled by the dead body of a man: why are we kept back, so that we may not offer an offering to the LORD at his appointed time among the children of Israel?

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto them, Stand still, and I will hear what the Lord will command concerning you.
verses.decoded: Moses said to them, 'Wait, and I will hear what the LORD commands concerning you.'

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And Moses spoke to Aaron and to all the assembly of the children of Israel, saying, These are the regulations of the Passover.

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto the Lord.
verses.decoded: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, If any man among you or among your descendants is unclean because of a dead body, or is on a distant journey, he shall still observe the Passover to the LORD.

verses.kjv: The fourteenth day of the second month at even they shall keep it, and eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
verses.decoded: On the fourteenth day of the second month, in the evening, they must observe it and eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

verses.kjv: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.
verses.decoded: They must not leave any of it until the morning, nor break any bone of it; they must observe it according to all the regulations of the Passover.

verses.kjv: But the man that is clean, and is not in a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of the Lord in his appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.
verses.decoded: But the person who is ceremonially clean and is not on a journey, and fails to observe the Passover, that same individual will be cut off from among their people: because they did not present the LORD's offering at its designated time, that person will bear the consequences of their sin.

verses.kjv: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto the Lord; according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to the manner thereof, so shall he do: ye shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.
verses.decoded: And if a foreigner lives among you and wants to observe the Passover to the Lord, he must do so according to the regulation of the Passover and its custom. You shall have one regulation, both for the foreigner and for the one who was born in the land.

verses.kjv: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle, namely, the tent of the testimony: and at even there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.
verses.decoded: And on the day that the tabernacle was set up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, specifically, the tent of the covenant; and in the evening there was on the tabernacle what appeared to be fire, until the morning.

verses.kjv: So it was alway: the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.
verses.decoded: So it was always: the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.

verses.kjv: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel pitched their tents.
verses.decoded: And when the cloud was lifted from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel traveled: and in the place where the cloud remained, there.

verses.kjv: At the commandment of the Lord the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the Lord they pitched: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.
verses.decoded: At the command of the LORD the Israelites traveled, and at the command of the LORD they camped; as long as the cloud remained over the tabernacle, they stayed in their tents.

verses.kjv: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of the Lord, and journeyed not.
verses.decoded: And when the cloud remained over the tabernacle for many days, the Israelites obeyed the command of the LORD and did not travel.

verses.kjv: And so it was, when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of the Lord they abode in their tents, and according to the commandment of the Lord they journeyed.
verses.decoded: And so it happened, when the cloud remained for a few days over the tabernacle, they stayed in their tents according to the command of the LORD, and they traveled according to the command of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And so it was, when the cloud abode from even unto the morning, and that the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether it was by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.
verses.decoded: And it happened, when the cloud remained from evening until morning, and when the cloud lifted in the morning, then they traveled: whether the cloud lifted during the day or during the night, they traveled.

verses.kjv: Or whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, remaining thereon, the children of Israel abode in their tents, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up, they journeyed.
verses.decoded: Whether it was two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud remained over the tabernacle, staying there, the Israelites stayed in their tents and did not travel; but when it was lifted, they traveled.

verses.kjv: At the commandment of the Lord they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of the Lord they journeyed: they kept the charge of the Lord, at the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
verses.decoded: At the command of the LORD they rested in the tents, and at the command of the LORD they traveled: they observed the instruction of the LORD, at the command of the LORD through Moses.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shalt thou make them: that thou mayest use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.
verses.decoded: Make two trumpets of silver. You shall make them from a single piece of hammered metal. You shall use them for calling the assembly together and for directing the movement of the camps.

verses.kjv: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to thee at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.decoded: And when they blow them, all the assembly will gather to you at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And if they blow but with one trumpet, then the princes, which are heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.
verses.decoded: And if they blow only one trumpet, then the leaders, who are heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather to you.

verses.kjv: When ye blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.
verses.decoded: When you sound an alarm, then the camps located on the east side will move forward.

verses.kjv: When ye blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
verses.decoded: And when you blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side will take their journey; and they will blow an alarm for their journeys.

verses.kjv: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.
verses.decoded: And when the assembly is to be brought together, you are to blow the trumpets, but not with a warning signal.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.
verses.decoded: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets; and they shall be for you as a lasting ordinance throughout your generations.

verses.kjv: And if ye go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresseth you, then ye shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before the Lord your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.
verses.decoded: And if you go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresses you, then you shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and you shall be remembered before the LORD your God, and you shall be saved from your enemies.

verses.kjv: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your God: I am the Lord your God.
verses.decoded: Also, on your days of celebration, and on your solemn days, and at the beginning of your months, you are to blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings, so that they may serve as a reminder for you before your God: I am the Lord your God.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the twentieth day of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the testimony.
verses.decoded: And it happened on the twentieth day of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was lifted from the tabernacle of the testimony.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.decoded: And the children of Israel traveled out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud settled in the wilderness of Paran.

verses.kjv: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
verses.decoded: And they set out for the first time as the Lord commanded through Moses.

verses.kjv: In the first place went the standard of the camp of the children of Judah according to their armies: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.decoded: First, the standard of the camp of the descendants of Judah marched according to their divisions; and Nahshon, the son of Amminadab, was in command of his army.

verses.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
verses.decoded: And over the army of the tribe of the descendants of Issachar was Nethaneel, the son of Zuar.

verses.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.decoded: And over the army of the tribe of the descendants of Zebulun was Eliab, the son of Helon.

verses.kjv: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.
verses.decoded: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari moved forward, carrying the tabernacle.

verses.kjv: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.decoded: Then the banner of the camp of Reuben moved forward with their divisions, and Elizur the son of Shedeur was in command of their army.

verses.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.decoded: And over the division of the tribe of Simeon was Shelumiel, the son of Zurishaddai.

verses.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
verses.decoded: And over the army of the tribe of Simeon was Shelumiel, the son of Zurishaddai.

verses.kjv: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and the other did set up the tabernacle against they came.
verses.decoded: And the Kohathites traveled onward, carrying the sanctuary; and the others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.

verses.kjv: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.decoded: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim moved forward according to their armies; and Elishama, the son of Ammihud, was over his army.

verses.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.decoded: And over the army of the tribe of the descendants of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

verses.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.decoded: And over the army of the tribe of the descendants of Benjamin was Abidan, the son of Gideoni.

verses.kjv: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, which was the rereward of all the camps throughout their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.decoded: And the rearguard of the camps of the descendants of Dan, with all their troops, organized by their divisions, will be the last of all the camps.

verses.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.decoded: And over the army of the tribe of the descendants of Asher was Pagiel, the son of Ocran.

verses.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.decoded: And over the army of the tribe of the descendants of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.

verses.kjv: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their armies, when they set forward.
verses.decoded: These were the travels of the children of Israel, organized by their military divisions, when they began their journey.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses’ father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which the Lord said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the Lord hath spoken good concerning Israel.
verses.decoded: And Moses said to Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses' father-in-law, "We are traveling to the place about which the LORD said, 'I will give it to you.' Come with us, and we will do good for you, because the LORD has promised good things concerning Israel."

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to mine own land, and to my kindred.
verses.decoded: And he said to him, I will not go; but I will leave for my own land, and to my relatives.

verses.kjv: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou mayest be to us instead of eyes.
verses.decoded: And he said, 'Please do not leave us, because you know how we are to camp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.'

verses.kjv: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness the Lord shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.
verses.decoded: And it will happen, if you go with us, yes, it will happen, that whatever good the LORD does for us, the same we will do for you.

verses.kjv: And they departed from the mount of the Lord three days’ journey: and the ark of the covenant of the Lord went before them in the three days’ journey, to search out a resting place for them.
verses.decoded: And they left the mountain of the LORD, traveling for three days; and the ark of the covenant of the LORD went ahead of them during the three days' journey, to find a resting place for them.

verses.kjv: And the cloud of the Lord was upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.
verses.decoded: And the cloud of the LORD was above them during the day, when they left the camp.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, Lord, and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.
verses.decoded: It happened that when the ark moved forward, Moses said, 'Rise up, LORD, and let your enemies be scattered; and let those who hate you flee before you.'

verses.kjv: And when it rested, he said, Return, O Lord, unto the many thousands of Israel.
verses.decoded: And when it stopped, he said, Return, O Lord, to the many thousands of Israel.

verses.kjv: And when the people complained, it displeased the Lord: and the Lord heard it; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of the Lord burnt among them, and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp.
verses.decoded: When the people complained, it displeased the LORD. The LORD heard it, and his anger was ignited. The fire of the LORD burned among them and consumed those who were in the farthest parts of the camp.

verses.kjv: And the people cried unto Moses; and when Moses prayed unto the Lord, the fire was quenched.
verses.decoded: And the people cried out to Moses; and when Moses prayed to the Lord, the fire was put out.

verses.kjv: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of the Lord burnt among them.
verses.decoded: And he named the place Taberah, because the fire of the Lord burned among them.

verses.kjv: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?
verses.decoded: The mixed crowd who were among them developed a strong craving, and the Israelites also cried again and said, 'Who will give us meat to eat?'

verses.kjv: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:
verses.decoded: We remember the fish that we ate in Egypt without cost; also the cucumbers, the melons, the leeks, the onions, and the garlic.

verses.kjv: But now our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.
verses.decoded: But now our appetite is gone; there is nothing at all except this manna before our eyes.

verses.kjv: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.
verses.decoded: And the manna was like coriander seed, and its color was like the color of bdellium.

verses.kjv: And the people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.
verses.decoded: And the people went around, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes from it; and its taste was like the taste of fresh oil.

verses.kjv: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.
verses.decoded: And when the dew fell on the camp during the night, the manna also fell on it.

verses.kjv: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of the Lord was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.
verses.decoded: Then Moses heard the people crying within their families, each man at the entrance of his tent; and the Lord's anger was greatly ignited; Moses was also displeased.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto the Lord, Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?
verses.decoded: And Moses said to the LORD, Why have you afflicted your servant? and why have I not found favor in your sight, that you place the burden of all these people upon me?

verses.kjv: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father beareth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?
verses.decoded: Did I conceive all these people? Did I give birth to them, so that you should say to me, Carry them in your arms, as a nursing father carries a baby, to the land which you promised to their fathers?

verses.kjv: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.
verses.decoded: Where would I get meat to give to all these people? because they cry to me, saying, Give us meat, so that we may eat.

verses.kjv: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
verses.decoded: I am not able to carry all these people by myself, because it is too burdensome for me.

verses.kjv: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.
verses.decoded: And if you deal this way with me, kill me, I ask you, immediately, if I have found favor in your sight; and do not let me see my misery.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with thee.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to Moses, Gather to me seventy men from the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people, and officers over them.

verses.kjv: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.
verses.decoded: And I will come down and talk with you there: and I will take some of the spirit that is upon you, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, so that you do not bear it yourself alone.

verses.kjv: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow, and ye shall eat flesh: for ye have wept in the ears of the Lord, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore the Lord will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.
verses.decoded: And say to the people, 'Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, and you will eat meat, because you have cried out to the LORD, saying, "Who will give us meat to eat?"'

verses.kjv: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;
verses.decoded: You will not eat for one day, or two days, or five days, or ten days, or twenty days;

verses.kjv: But even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that ye have despised the Lord which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?
verses.decoded: But even for a whole month, until it comes out of your nostrils, and it becomes repulsive to you: because you have rejected the LORD who is among you,

verses.kjv: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.
verses.decoded: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand infantrymen; and you have said, I will give them meat, so that they may eat for a whole month.

verses.kjv: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?
verses.decoded: If the flocks and herds were killed for them, would that be enough for them? Or if all the fish of the sea were gathered for them, would that be enough for them?

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Is the Lord’s hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.
verses.decoded: And the Lord said to Moses, Is the Lord's power limited? You will now see whether my word will come true for you or not.

verses.kjv: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the Lord, and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.
verses.decoded: And Moses went out and told the people the words of the LORD, and gathered the seventy men from among the elders of the people, and placed them around the.

verses.kjv: And the Lord came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.
verses.decoded: And the Lord came down in a cloud, and spoke to him, and took some of the spirit that was on him, and gave it to the seventy elders: and it happened that, when the spirit rested on them, they prophesied, and did not stop.

verses.kjv: But there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.
verses.decoded: However, two of the men remained in the camp; one was named Eldad, and the other Medad. The spirit rested upon them, and they were among those who were registered, and they prophesied in the camp.

verses.kjv: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.
verses.decoded: A young man ran and told Moses, saying, 'Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp.'

verses.kjv: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.
verses.decoded: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto him, Enviest thou for my sake? would God that all the Lord’s people were prophets, and that the Lord would put his spirit upon them!
verses.decoded: And Moses said to him, Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all the LORD'S people were prophets, and that the LORD would put his spirit on them!

verses.kjv: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
verses.decoded: And Moses went into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

verses.kjv: And there went forth a wind from the Lord, and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, as it were a day’s journey on this side, and as it were a day’s journey on the other side, round about the camp, and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth.
verses.decoded: Then a wind came from the Lord and brought quails from the sea, causing them to fall around the camp, extending approximately a day's journey on one side and a day's journey on the other side, all around the camp, and about three feet high on the surface of the ground.

verses.kjv: And the people stood up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.
verses.decoded: The people stood up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails. The one who gathered the least collected ten homers, and they spread them all out for themselves around the camp, and all the way for a two-day journey on this side, and similarly a two-day journey on the other side, around the camp, and about three feet high on the surface of the ground.

verses.kjv: And while the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the wrath of the Lord was kindled against the people, and the Lord smote the people with a very great plague.
verses.decoded: And while the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, the anger of the Lord was ignited against the people, and the Lord struck the people with a very severe plague.

verses.kjv: And he called the name of that place Kibroth-hattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.
verses.decoded: And he named that place Kibrothhattaavah, because there they buried the people who had a strong craving.

verses.kjv: And the people journeyed from Kibroth-hattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.
verses.decoded: And the people traveled from Kibrothhattaavah to Hazeroth; and remained at Hazeroth.

verses.kjv: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married: for he had married an Ethiopian woman.
verses.decoded: And Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married: for he had married an Ethiopian woman.

verses.kjv: And they said, Hath the Lord indeed spoken only by Moses? hath he not spoken also by us? And the Lord heard it.
verses.decoded: And they said, Has the LORD indeed spoken only through Moses? Has he not also spoken through us? And the LORD heard it.

verses.kjv: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)
verses.decoded: (Now Moses was a very humble man, more so than all the men who were on the face of the earth.)

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out.
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke suddenly to Moses, and to Aaron, and to Miriam, 'Come out, you three, to the tent of meeting.' And they three came out.

verses.kjv: And the Lord came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.
verses.decoded: And the LORD came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came out.

verses.kjv: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I the Lord will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.
verses.decoded: And he said, Listen now to my words: If there is a prophet among you, I the LORD will make myself known to him in a vision, and will speak to him in a dream.

verses.kjv: My servant Moses is not so, who is faithful in all mine house.
verses.decoded: My servant Moses is not like that; he is faithful in all my house.

verses.kjv: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the Lord shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?
verses.decoded: I will speak with him face to face, clearly, and not in riddles; and he will see the form of the LORD. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?

verses.kjv: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against them; and he departed.
verses.decoded: And the LORD became angry with them; and he left.

verses.kjv: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam became leprous, white as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, she was leprous.
verses.decoded: And the cloud moved away from the tabernacle; and, look, Miriam became leprous, as white as snow: and Aaron looked at Miriam, and, look, she was leprous.

verses.kjv: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.
verses.decoded: And Aaron said to Moses, Oh no, my master, I beg you, do not hold this sin against us, in which we have acted foolishly and in which we have sinned.

verses.kjv: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother’s womb.
verses.decoded: Do not let her be like someone who is dead, whose flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother's womb.

verses.kjv: And Moses cried unto the Lord, saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech thee.
verses.decoded: And Moses called out to the Lord, saying, Heal her now, O God, I beg you.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in again.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to Moses, If her father had only spit in her face, would she not be ashamed for seven days? She should be shut out from the camp for seven days, and after that she should be received in again.

verses.kjv: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.
verses.decoded: And Miriam was kept outside the camp for seven days, and the people did not travel until Miriam was brought back in.

verses.kjv: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.decoded: And afterward the people moved from Hazeroth and camped in the wilderness of Paran.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.
verses.decoded: Send men, so that they may explore the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites: from each tribe of their ancestors you shall send a man, every one a leader among them.

verses.kjv: And Moses by the commandment of the Lord sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran by the command of the Lord. All those men were leaders of the children of Israel.

verses.kjv: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
verses.decoded: These were their names: from the tribe of Reuben, Shammua, the son of Zaccur.

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
verses.decoded: From the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat, the son of Hori.

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.decoded: From the tribe of Judah, Caleb, the son of Jephunneh.

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
verses.decoded: From the tribe of Issachar, Igal, the son of Joseph.

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.
verses.decoded: From the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea, the son of Nun.

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
verses.decoded: From the tribe of Benjamin, Palti, the son of Raphu.

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
verses.decoded: From the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel, son of Sodi.

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
verses.decoded: From the tribe of Joseph, specifically from the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi, the son of Susi.

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
verses.decoded: From the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
verses.decoded: From the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
verses.decoded: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
verses.decoded: From the tribe of Joseph, specifically, from the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi, the son of Susi.

verses.kjv: These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.
verses.decoded: These are the names of the men whom Moses sent to explore the land. And Moses called Oshea, the son of Nun, Joshua.

verses.kjv: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:
verses.decoded: And Moses sent them to explore the land of Canaan, and said to them, Go up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:

verses.kjv: And see the land, what it is; and the people that dwelleth therein, whether they be strong or weak, few or many;
verses.decoded: And observe the land, what it is like; and the people who live there, whether they are strong or weak, few or many;

verses.kjv: And what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;
verses.decoded: And what the land is like, whether it is fertile or barren, whether there are trees in it or not: and what kind of cities they live in, whether in tents or in fortified cities;

verses.kjv: And what the land is, whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the firstripe grapes.
verses.decoded: And what the land is like, whether it is fertile or barren, whether there are trees in it or not. And be courageous, and bring back some of the land's produce. Now it was the season for the first ripe grapes.

verses.kjv: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.
verses.decoded: So they went up and explored the land from the Wilderness of Zin to Rehob, as people go to Hamath.

verses.kjv: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
verses.decoded: They went up through the southern region and came to Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, lived. Hebron had been built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.

verses.kjv: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.
verses.decoded: And they came to the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they carried it between two people on a staff;

verses.kjv: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.
verses.decoded: The place was called the Valley of Eshcol because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from there.

verses.kjv: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.
verses.decoded: And they returned from exploring the land after forty days.

verses.kjv: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.
verses.decoded: They went to Moses, Aaron, and the entire assembly of the Israelites, in the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and reported to them and to the entire assembly, and showed them the produce of the land.

verses.kjv: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.
verses.decoded: And they told him, and said, We came to the land where you sent us, and surely it flows with milk and honey; and this is its fruit.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.
verses.decoded: However, the people who live in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large; and in addition, we saw the descendants of Anak there.

verses.kjv: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.
verses.decoded: The Amalekites live in the southern land; and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, live in the mountains; and the Canaanites live by the sea and along the Jordan River.

verses.kjv: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.
verses.decoded: And Caleb calmed the people in front of Moses, and said, 'Let us go up immediately and take possession of it, because we are certainly able to conquer it.'

verses.kjv: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.
verses.decoded: But the men who had gone with him said, 'We are not able to go up against the people, because they are stronger than we.'

verses.kjv: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.
verses.decoded: And they spread a bad report about the land they had explored to the Israelites, saying, 'The land we explored is a land that consumes its inhabitants; and all the people we saw there are people of great size.'

verses.kjv: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.
verses.decoded: And there we saw the giants, the descendants of Anak, who came from the giants; and we considered ourselves like grasshoppers, and that is how we appeared to them.

verses.kjv: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
verses.decoded: And the entire community raised their voices and cried out; and the people wept that night.

verses.kjv: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!
verses.decoded: And all the people of Israel complained against Moses and against Aaron. And the entire community said to them, 'We wish we had died in the land of Egypt! Or we wish we had died in this wilderness!'

verses.kjv: And wherefore hath the Lord brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?
verses.decoded: And why has the LORD brought us to this land to die by the sword, so that our wives and our children would become plunder? Wouldn't it be better for us to return to Egypt?

verses.kjv: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.
verses.decoded: And they said to one another, Let us appoint a leader and return to Egypt.

verses.kjv: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces in front of the entire gathering of the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:
verses.decoded: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were among those who explored the land, tore their clothes.

verses.kjv: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land.
verses.decoded: And they spoke to the entire community of the Israelites, saying, The land, which we explored, is an extremely good land.

verses.kjv: If the Lord delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.
verses.decoded: If the LORD is pleased with us, then he will lead us into this land and give it to us; a land that flows with milk and honey.

verses.kjv: Only rebel not ye against the Lord, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and the Lord is with us: fear them not.
verses.decoded: Only do not rebel against the LORD, nor fear the people of the land; for they are like bread for us: their protection has left them, and the LORD is with us: do not fear them.

verses.kjv: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of the Lord appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: But the entire congregation commanded that they be stoned. And the glory of the LORD appeared in the Tent of Meeting before all the children of Israel.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?
verses.decoded: And the Lord said to Moses, How long will these people provoke me? And how long will it be before they believe me, despite all the signs which I have shown among them?

verses.kjv: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.
verses.decoded: I will strike them with the plague, and dispossess them, and will make you a nation greater and more powerful than them.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto the Lord, Then the Egyptians shall hear it, (for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;)
verses.decoded: And Moses said to the LORD, Then the Egyptians will hear it, (for you brought up this people in your might from among them;)

verses.kjv: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that thou Lord art among this people, that thou Lord art seen face to face, and that thy cloud standeth over them, and that thou goest before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.
verses.decoded: And they will tell it to the residents of this land, because they have heard that you, Lord, are among these people, that you, Lord, are seen face to face, and that your cloud stands over them, and that you go before them by day in a pillar of cloud and in a pillar of fire by night.

verses.kjv: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,
verses.decoded: Now if you kill all these people at once, then the nations who have heard about your reputation will say,

verses.kjv: Because the Lord was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.
verses.decoded: Because the LORD was unable to bring this people into the land which he swore to them, therefore he has killed them in the wilderness.

verses.kjv: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my Lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,
verses.decoded: And now, I beg you, let the power of my Lord be great, just as you have spoken, saying,

verses.kjv: The Lord is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.
verses.decoded: The LORD is patient and has great compassion, forgiving wrongdoing and rebellion, but will by no means leave the guilty unpunished, punishing the wrongdoing of parents on their children, even to the third and fourth generation.

verses.kjv: Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.
verses.decoded: I beg you, forgive the sin of these people according to the greatness of your mercy, and just as you have forgiven these people from Egypt until now.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said, I have pardoned according to thy word:
verses.decoded: And the Lord said, I have forgiven according to your word:

verses.kjv: But as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the Lord.
verses.decoded: But as surely as I live, all the earth will be filled with the glory of the Lord.

verses.kjv: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;
verses.decoded: Because all those men who have seen my glory and my miracles, which I performed in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tested me now these ten times,

verses.kjv: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:
verses.decoded: Certainly they will not see the land which I promised to their fathers, nor will any of those who angered me see it.

verses.kjv: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.
verses.decoded: But my servant Caleb, because he had a different spirit with him, and has followed me completely, I will bring him into the land where he went; and his descendants will possess it.

verses.kjv: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) To morrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
verses.decoded: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites lived in the valley.) Tomorrow you turn, and go into the wilderness by way of the Red Sea.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

verses.kjv: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.
verses.decoded: How long must I endure this wicked assembly, who complain against me? I have heard the complaints of the Israelites, which they make against me.

verses.kjv: Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith the Lord, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:
verses.decoded: Tell them, 'As surely as I live,' says the Lord, 'as you have spoken in my hearing, so I will do to you.'

verses.kjv: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, which have murmured against me,
verses.decoded: Your dead bodies will fall in this wilderness, and all of you who were counted, according to your total number, from twenty years old and older, who have complained against me, will die in this wilderness.

verses.kjv: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.decoded: Certainly you will not enter the land about which I swore to settle you in it, except for Caleb the son of Jephunneh and Joshua the son of Nun.

verses.kjv: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.
verses.decoded: But your children, whom you said would become plunder, I will bring them in, and they will know the land which you have rejected.

verses.kjv: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.
verses.decoded: But as for you, your bodies will fall in this wilderness.

verses.kjv: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.
verses.decoded: And your children will wander in the wilderness for forty years, and bear the burden of your unfaithfulness, until your bodies waste away in the wilderness.

verses.kjv: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.
verses.decoded: According to the number of days in which you explored the land, specifically forty days, each day representing a year, you will bear your wrongdoing, specifically forty years, and you will experience my broken promise.

verses.kjv: I the Lord have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.
verses.decoded: I, the LORD, have said that I will certainly do this to all this wicked assembly who have gathered against me: in this wilderness they will be destroyed, and there they will die.

verses.kjv: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,
verses.decoded: And the men whom Moses sent to explore the land, who returned and caused the entire community to complain against him by spreading a negative report about the land,

verses.kjv: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the Lord.
verses.decoded: Even those men who brought a bad report about the land died from a plague before the Lord.

verses.kjv: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived still.
verses.decoded: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were among the men who went to explore the land, remained alive.

verses.kjv: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.
verses.decoded: And Moses told these statements to all the children of Israel, and the people mourned greatly.

verses.kjv: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we be here, and will go up unto the place which the Lord hath promised: for we have sinned.
verses.decoded: And they got up early in the morning, and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, Look, we are here, and will go up to the place which the Lord has promised.

verses.kjv: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the Lord? but it shall not prosper.
verses.decoded: And Moses said, Why now are you disobeying the command of the Lord? but it will not succeed.
