verses.kjv: Go not up, for the Lord is not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.
verses.decoded: Do not go up, because the Lord is not among you, so that you will not be defeated by your enemies.

verses.kjv: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned away from the Lord, therefore the Lord will not be with you.
verses.decoded: Because the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, you will fall by the sword, because you have turned away from the LORD, therefore the LORD will not be with you.

verses.kjv: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.
verses.decoded: But they dared to go up to the hilltop; however, the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and Moses, did not leave the camp.

verses.kjv: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.
verses.decoded: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who lived in that hill, and attacked them, and defeated them, all the way to Hormah.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,
verses.decoded: Speak to the children of Israel and say to them, 'When you come into the land where you will live, which I give to you,'

verses.kjv: And will make an offering by fire unto the Lord, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto the Lord, of the herd, or of the flock:
verses.decoded: And will present an offering by fire to the LORD, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice made to fulfill a vow, or as a freewill offering, or during your appointed festivals,

verses.kjv: Then shall he that offereth his offering unto the Lord bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.
verses.decoded: Then the one who presents his offering to the LORD must bring a grain offering consisting of one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with one-fourth of a hin of oil.

verses.kjv: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.
verses.decoded: And a fifth of a hin of wine for a drink offering you shall prepare with the burnt offering or for a sacrifice, for one lamb.

verses.kjv: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil.
verses.decoded: Or for a ram, you shall prepare for a grain offering two-tenths of an ephah of flour mixed with one-third of a hin of oil.

verses.kjv: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine, for a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.decoded: And for a drink offering you shall offer one-third of a hin of wine, as a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto the Lord:
verses.decoded: And when you prepare a bull for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings to the LORD:

verses.kjv: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.
verses.decoded: Then he shall bring with a young bull a grain offering of three-tenths of a measure of flour mixed with half a hin of oil.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.decoded: And you shall bring as a drink offering half a hin of wine, as an offering made by fire, as a pleasing aroma to the Lord.

verses.kjv: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.
verses.decoded: This is to be done for one bull, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or for a young goat.

verses.kjv: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.
verses.decoded: According to the number that you will prepare, so you will do to everyone according to their number.

verses.kjv: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.decoded: All who are native-born shall do these things in this way, when presenting an offering made by fire, as a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever be among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord; as ye do, so he shall do.
verses.decoded: And if a foreigner lives among you, or anyone else among you in your future generations, and wants to present an offering made by fire that is pleasing to the Lord, they must do it in the same way you do.

verses.kjv: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you, an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye are, so shall the stranger be before the Lord.
verses.decoded: There shall be one law for both you, the members of the community, and for the foreigner who lives among you. This law is to be permanent throughout your generations. Just as you are, so shall the foreigner be before the LORD.

verses.kjv: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.
verses.decoded: One law and one custom will apply to you, and to the foreigner who resides among you.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,
verses.decoded: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, When you come into the land where I bring you,

verses.kjv: Then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up an heave offering unto the Lord.
verses.decoded: Then it will be that, when you eat bread from the land, you must present a heave offering to the LORD.

verses.kjv: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering: as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.
verses.decoded: You shall offer a cake from the first portion of your dough as a raised offering; just as you present the raised offering from the threshing floor, so you shall present it.

verses.kjv: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the Lord an heave offering in your generations.
verses.decoded: From the first portion of your dough, you shall give to the LORD a heave offering throughout your generations.

verses.kjv: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the Lord hath spoken unto Moses,
verses.decoded: And if you have made a mistake, and not followed all these commandments, which the Lord has spoken to Moses,

verses.kjv: Even all that the Lord hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the Lord commanded Moses, and henceforward among your generations;
verses.decoded: Even everything that the LORD has commanded you through Moses, from the day when the LORD gave commands through Moses, and for all your future generations;

verses.kjv: Then it shall be, if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour unto the Lord, with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.
verses.decoded: Then it will be, if anything is done unintentionally without the congregation's knowledge, that the entire congregation must offer one young bull as a burnt offering, as a pleasing aroma to the Lord, along with its grain offering and its drink offering, as prescribed, and one young goat as a sin offering.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them; for it is ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord, and their sin offering before the Lord, for their ignorance:
verses.decoded: And the priest will make atonement for the entire community of the children of Israel, and they will be forgiven, because it was done in ignorance; and they will bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire to the LORD, and their sin offering before the LORD, because of their ignorance.

verses.kjv: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; seeing all the people were in ignorance.
verses.decoded: And it will be forgiven all the community of the descendants of Israel, and the foreigner who lives among them, because all the people acted unknowingly.

verses.kjv: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.
verses.decoded: And if any person sins unintentionally, then that person must bring a female goat one year old as a sin offering.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly, when he sinneth by ignorance before the Lord, to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.decoded: And the priest will make atonement for the person who sins unintentionally, when he sins unintentionally before the Lord, to make atonement for him; and he will be forgiven.

verses.kjv: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance, both for him that is born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.
verses.decoded: You will have one law for anyone who sins unintentionally, both for those born among the Israelites and for the foreigner who lives among them.

verses.kjv: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously, whether he be born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth the Lord; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.decoded: However, the person who acts defiantly, whether he is a native-born person or a foreigner, insults the Lord; and that person will be cut off from among his people.

verses.kjv: Because he hath despised the word of the Lord, and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.
verses.decoded: Because he has despised the word of the Lord, and has broken his command, that person will certainly be cut off; his wrongdoing will be his own responsibility.

verses.kjv: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day.
verses.decoded: And while the Israelites were in the wilderness, they found a man who was gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.

verses.kjv: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.
verses.decoded: And those who found him in the wilderness gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.

verses.kjv: And they put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done to him.
verses.decoded: And they placed him in custody, because it had not been decided what should be done with him.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, The man shall be surely put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.
verses.decoded: And the Lord said to Moses, The man must certainly be put to death; all the assembly shall stone him with stones outside the camp.

verses.kjv: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: And the entire assembly brought him outside the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died; just as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:
verses.decoded: Speak to the children of Israel, and instruct them to make fringes for themselves on the edges of their garments throughout their generations.

verses.kjv: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the Lord, and do them; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring:
verses.decoded: And it will be for you as a tassel, so that you may look at it and remember all the commands of the LORD and obey them; and so that you do not follow your own heart and your own eyes, after which you are accustomed to stray.

verses.kjv: That ye may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.
verses.decoded: So that you may remember, and do all my commands, and be holy to your God.

verses.kjv: I am the Lord your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the Lord your God.
verses.decoded: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the Lord your God.

verses.kjv: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:
verses.decoded: Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, gathered men.

verses.kjv: And they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown:
verses.decoded: And they stood up against Moses, along with some of the Israelites, two hundred and fifty leaders of the assembly, well-known in the community, men of prominence:

verses.kjv: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the Lord is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the Lord?
verses.decoded: And they assembled against Moses and Aaron, and said to them, You take too much upon yourselves, since all the community is holy, every one of them, and the LORD is among them: why then do you exalt yourselves above the community of the LORD?

verses.kjv: And when Moses heard it, he fell upon his face:
verses.decoded: When Moses heard this, he fell on his face.

verses.kjv: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, Even to morrow the Lord will shew who are his, and who is holy; and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he hath chosen will he cause to come near unto him.
verses.decoded: And he spoke to Korah and to all his company, saying, Tomorrow the LORD will show who belongs to him, and who is holy; and will cause him to come near to him: even him whom he has chosen will he cause to come near to him.

verses.kjv: This do; Take you censers, Korah, and all his company;
verses.decoded: Do this; Take your censers, Korah, and all his company;

verses.kjv: And put fire therein, and put incense in them before the Lord to morrow: and it shall be that the man whom the Lord doth choose, he shall be holy: ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.
verses.decoded: And put fire in them, and put incense in them before the LORD tomorrow: and it will be that the man whom the LORD chooses, he will be holy: you.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear, I pray you, ye sons of Levi:
verses.decoded: And Moses said to Korah, Please listen, you sons of Levi.

verses.kjv: Seemeth it but a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the Lord, and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?
verses.decoded: Does it seem to you a small thing that the God of Israel has separated you from the assembly of Israel, to bring you close to himself to perform the service of the Lord's tabernacle,

verses.kjv: And he hath brought thee near to him, and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee: and seek ye the priesthood also?
verses.decoded: And he has brought you near to him, and all your brothers, the sons of Levi, with you; and do you also seek the priesthood?

verses.kjv: For which cause both thou and all thy company are gathered together against the Lord: and what is Aaron, that ye murmur against him?
verses.decoded: Because of this, both you and all your group have assembled against the LORD; and who is Aaron, that you complain against him?

verses.kjv: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: which said, We will not come up:
verses.decoded: And Moses sent to summon Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, but they said, 'We will not come.'

verses.kjv: Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us?
verses.decoded: Isn't it enough that you have brought us out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, unless you also make yourself entirely a ruler over us?

verses.kjv: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.
verses.decoded: Furthermore, you have not brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor have you given us an inheritance of fields and vineyards. Do you intend to deceive these men? We will not come.

verses.kjv: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto the Lord, Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.
verses.decoded: And Moses was very angry, and said to the Lord, Do not accept their offering: I have not taken a single donkey from them, nor have I harmed any of them.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before the Lord, thou, and they, and Aaron, to morrow:
verses.decoded: And Moses said to Korah, You and all your company be before the LORD, you, and they, and Aaron, tomorrow.

verses.kjv: And take every man his censer, and put incense in them, and bring ye before the Lord every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each of you his censer.
verses.decoded: And each man is to take his censer, and put incense in them, and you are to bring each man's censer before the Lord, two hundred and fifty censers;

verses.kjv: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron.
verses.decoded: And each man took his censer, and put fire in them, and placed incense on it, and stood at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting with Moses and Aaron.

verses.kjv: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the glory of the Lord appeared unto all the congregation.
verses.decoded: And Korah gathered all the assembly against them to the entrance of the tabernacle of the assembly; and the glory of the Lord appeared to all the assembly.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

verses.kjv: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.
verses.decoded: Separate yourselves from among this assembly, so that I may destroy them instantly.

verses.kjv: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?
verses.decoded: And they fell on their faces and said, 'O God, the God of the spirits of all humanity, if one man sins, will you be angry with the entire community?'

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.
verses.decoded: Speak to the congregation, saying, Move away from around the dwellings of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.

verses.kjv: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.
verses.decoded: And Moses got up and went to Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

verses.kjv: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.
verses.decoded: And he spoke to the assembly, saying, Move away, I ask you, from the dwellings of these evil men, and do not touch anything belonging to them, so that you are not destroyed by all their sins.

verses.kjv: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.
verses.decoded: So they moved away from the dwelling of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, from all sides; and Dathan and Abiram came out and stood at the entrance of their tents,

verses.kjv: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that the Lord hath sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of mine own mind.
verses.decoded: And Moses said, By this you will know that the LORD has sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them on my own initiative.

verses.kjv: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then the Lord hath not sent me.
verses.decoded: If these men die a natural death like all other people, or if they experience what all other people experience, then the Lord has not sent me.

verses.kjv: But if the Lord make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down quick into the pit; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the Lord.
verses.decoded: But if the LORD creates something new, and the earth opens its mouth and swallows them, along with everything that belongs to them, and they go down alive into the pit,

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them:
verses.decoded: And it happened, when he had finished speaking all these words, that the ground underneath them split apart.

verses.kjv: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.
verses.decoded: And the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them, and their houses, and all the men who belonged to Korah, and all their possessions.

verses.kjv: They, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.
verses.decoded: They, and all that belonged to them, went down alive into the grave, and the earth closed over them; and they died and were removed from the community.

verses.kjv: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them: for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up also.
verses.decoded: And all the Israelites who were around them fled at their outcry, because they said, 'What if the earth swallows us too?'

verses.kjv: And there came out a fire from the Lord, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.
verses.decoded: And a fire came out from the LORD, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men who offered incense.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are hallowed.
verses.decoded: Speak to Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning coals, and you scatter the fire over there; for they are holy.

verses.kjv: The censers of these sinners against their own souls, let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before the Lord, therefore they are hallowed: and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: The censers of these men who sinned against themselves are to be made into broad plates for a covering of the altar, because they offered them before the LORD, therefore they are consecrated.

verses.kjv: And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers, wherewith they that were burnt had offered; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar:
verses.decoded: And Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers with which those who had been consumed by fire had offered; and they were hammered into wide plates to cover the altar.

verses.kjv: To be a memorial unto the children of Israel, that no stranger, which is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to offer incense before the Lord; that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as the Lord said to him by the hand of Moses.
verses.decoded: This is to be a reminder to the Israelites that no unauthorized person, who is not a descendant of Aaron, should approach to offer incense before the Lord, so that he does not become like Korah and his group, just as the Lord told him through Moses.

verses.kjv: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of the Lord.
verses.decoded: But on the next day, all the assembly of the Israelites complained against Moses and against Aaron, saying, 'You have killed the people of the LORD.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the congregation was gathered against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the Lord appeared.
verses.decoded: And it happened that when the assembly gathered against Moses and Aaron, they looked toward the tent of meeting, and suddenly the cloud covered it, and the glory of the Lord appeared.

verses.kjv: And Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.decoded: Moses and Aaron came before the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.
verses.decoded: Get away from this assembly, so that I may destroy them instantly. And they fell on their faces.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and put on incense, and go quickly unto the congregation, and make an atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from the Lord; the plague is begun.
verses.decoded: And Moses said to Aaron, Take a censer, and put fire in it from the altar, and put incense on it, and go quickly to the congregation, and make atonement for them, because wrath has gone out from the LORD; the plague has begun.

verses.kjv: And Aaron took as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the congregation; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people.
verses.decoded: And Aaron took as Moses commanded, and ran into the middle of the assembly; and, look, the plague had begun among the people: and he put on incense, and made atonement for the people.

verses.kjv: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
verses.decoded: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stopped.

verses.kjv: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, beside them that died about the matter of Korah.
verses.decoded: Now, those who died in the plague were fourteen thousand seven hundred, in addition to those who died because of Korah's rebellion.

verses.kjv: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the plague was stayed.
verses.decoded: And Aaron returned to Moses to the door of the tent of meeting, and the plague stopped.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of their fathers, of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods: write thou every man’s name upon his rod.
verses.decoded: Speak to the children of Israel, and take from every one of them a staff according to their ancestral house, from all their leaders according to their ancestral houses, twelve staffs: you shall write each man's name upon his staff.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt write Aaron’s name upon the rod of Levi: for one rod shall be for the head of the house of their fathers.
verses.decoded: And you shall write Aaron's name on the staff of Levi: for one staff shall be for the head of the household of their fathers.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony, where I will meet with you.
verses.decoded: And you shall place them in the Tent of Meeting before the covenant, where I will meet with you.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that the man’s rod, whom I shall choose, shall blossom: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, whereby they murmur against you.
verses.decoded: It will happen that the staff of the man whom I choose will sprout, and I will stop the complaints from the Israelites against me.

verses.kjv: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, for each prince one, according to their fathers’ houses, even twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.
verses.decoded: And Moses spoke to the children of Israel, and each of their leaders gave him a rod, one for each leader, according to their ancestral families, specifically twelve rods; and Aaron's rod was among their rods.

verses.kjv: And Moses laid up the rods before the Lord in the tabernacle of witness.
verses.decoded: And Moses placed the rods before the Lord in the tabernacle of testimony.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.
verses.decoded: The next day, Moses went into the tent of testimony. There, Aaron's staff, representing the tribe of Levi, had sprouted, produced buds, blossomed, and yielded almonds.

verses.kjv: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the Lord unto all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.
verses.decoded: And Moses brought out all the staffs from before the Lord to all the people of Israel; and they looked, and each man took his staff.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Bring Aaron’s rod again before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the rebels; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me, that they die not.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to Moses, Bring Aaron's staff back before the testimony, to be kept as a sign against the rebels; and you shall completely remove their complaints from me, so that they do not die.

verses.kjv: And Moses did so: as the Lord commanded him, so did he.
verses.decoded: And Moses did so; just as the LORD commanded him, he did.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses, saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.
verses.decoded: And the Israelites spoke to Moses, saying, Look, we are dying, we are perishing, we are all perishing.

verses.kjv: Whosoever cometh any thing near unto the tabernacle of the Lord shall die: shall we be consumed with dying?
verses.decoded: And the children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, Look, we are dying, we are perishing, we are all perishing.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy father’s house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.
verses.decoded: And the Lord said to Aaron, "You and your sons and your father's household with you will be responsible for the wrongdoing concerning the sanctuary; and you and your sons with you will be responsible for the wrongdoing of your priesthood."

verses.kjv: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tabernacle of witness.
verses.decoded: And your relatives also from the tribe of Levi, your father's tribe, bring with you, so that they may be united with you and serve you: but...

verses.kjv: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor ye also, die.
verses.decoded: And they shall be responsible for your duties, and the duties of all the tabernacle: however, they must not come near the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, so that they do not die, neither you, nor they.

verses.kjv: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, for all the service of the tabernacle: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.
verses.decoded: And they will be joined with you, and they will be responsible for the duties of the tent of meeting, for all the service of the tent: and an unauthorized person must not come near you.

verses.kjv: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: And you shall keep the responsibility of the sanctuary, and the responsibility of the altar, so that there will be no more wrath upon the children of Israel.

verses.kjv: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you they are given as a gift for the Lord, to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.decoded: And I have taken your fellow Levites from among the Israelites; they are given to you as a gift for the Lord, to perform the service of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.kjv: Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest’s office for every thing of the altar, and within the vail; and ye shall serve: I have given your priest’s office unto you as a service of gift: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.decoded: Therefore you and your sons with you shall perform your priestly service for everything concerning the altar and within the veil; and you shall serve: I have given your priestly service to you as a gift: and any unauthorized person who approaches shall be put to death.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Aaron, Behold, I also have given thee the charge of mine heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, by an ordinance for ever.
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Aaron, Indeed, I also have given you the responsibility for my heave offerings, all the holy things of the people of Israel; I have given them to you and to your sons because of your anointing, as a lasting regulation.

verses.kjv: This shall be thine of the most holy things, reserved from the fire: every oblation of theirs, every meat offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall render unto me, shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons.
verses.decoded: This will be yours from the most holy things, set aside from the fire: every offering of theirs, every grain offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they present to me, will be most holy for you and for your sons.

verses.kjv: In the most holy place shalt thou eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy unto thee.
verses.decoded: You shall eat it in the most holy place; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy to you.

verses.kjv: And this is thine; the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel: I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.
verses.decoded: And this is yours; the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel: I have given them to you, and to your sons and to your daughters with you, by a permanent decree: everyone who is clean in your house may eat of it.

verses.kjv: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto the Lord, them have I given thee.
verses.decoded: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they offer to the LORD, I have given them to you.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever is first ripe in the land, which they shall bring unto the Lord, shall be thine; every one that is clean in thine house shall eat of it.
verses.decoded: And whatever is first ripe in the land, which they bring to the Lord, shall be yours; everyone who is ceremonially clean in your house may eat of it.

verses.kjv: Every thing devoted in Israel shall be thine.
verses.decoded: Everything dedicated in Israel will be yours.

verses.kjv: Every thing that openeth the matrix in all flesh, which they bring unto the Lord, whether it be of men or beasts, shall be thine: nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem.
verses.decoded: Every firstborn of every living thing that they bring to the Lord, whether human or animal, will be yours. However, you must certainly redeem every firstborn human, and you must not redeem the firstborn of unclean animals.

verses.kjv: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shalt thou redeem, according to thine estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.
verses.decoded: And those who are to be redeemed from one month old you shall redeem, according to your valuation, for the sum of five shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel, which is twenty gerahs.

verses.kjv: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, thou shalt not redeem; they are holy: thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shalt burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.decoded: However, you must not redeem the firstborn of a cow, or the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat; they are holy. You must sprinkle their blood on the altar and burn their fat as an offering made by fire, as a pleasing aroma to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are thine.
verses.decoded: And their meat shall be yours, just as the wave offering of the breast and the right thigh are yours.

verses.kjv: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer unto the Lord, have I given thee, and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: it is a covenant of salt for ever before the Lord unto thee and to thy seed with thee.
verses.decoded: All the contributions of the sacred things, which the Israelites offer to the Lord, I have given to you, and your sons and your daughters with you, as a permanent regulation: it is a perpetual covenant of salt before the Lord to you and to your descendants with you.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any part among them: I am thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Aaron, 'You shall have no inheritance in their land, nor shall you have any portion among them: I am your portion and your inheritance.'

verses.kjv: And, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.decoded: And look, I have given the descendants of Levi all the tenth in Israel as an inheritance, for the work they perform, specifically the work of the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation, lest they bear sin, and die.
verses.decoded: The Israelites must no longer come near the tabernacle of the assembly from now on, so that they do not incur guilt and die.

verses.kjv: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations, that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance.
verses.decoded: But the Levites will perform the service of the Tent of Meeting, and they will bear the responsibility for any wrongdoing related to it. This will be a permanent regulation for all your future generations; and they will have no land inheritance among the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: But the tithes of the children of Israel, which they offer as an heave offering unto the Lord, I have given to the Levites to inherit: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.
verses.decoded: However, the offerings from the people of Israel, which they present as a special contribution to the Lord, I have given to the Levites as their inheritance.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Thus speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up an heave offering of it for the Lord, even a tenth part of the tithe.
verses.decoded: Therefore, speak to the Levites and tell them, 'When you receive from the Israelites the tithes which I have given you from them as your inheritance, then you must present a contribution from it to the LORD, specifically, a tenth of the tithe.'

verses.kjv: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.
verses.decoded: And this raised offering of yours will be counted for you as if it were the grain from the threshing floor and the full produce of the winepress.

verses.kjv: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the Lord of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and ye shall give thereof the Lord’s heave offering to Aaron the priest.
verses.decoded: In this way you also will offer a heave offering to the LORD from all your tithes, which you receive from the children of Israel; and you will give from it the LORD's heave offering to Aaron the priest.

verses.kjv: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the Lord, of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.
verses.decoded: From all your offerings, you must present every special contribution to the LORD, from the best of them, specifically the sacred portion from it.

verses.kjv: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.
verses.decoded: Therefore you shall say to them, 'When you have set aside the best portion from it, then it will be credited to the Levites as the produce of the threshing floor and as the produce of the winepress.'

verses.kjv: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.decoded: And you may eat it in any place, you and your households, because it is your compensation for your service in the Tent of Meeting.

verses.kjv: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.
verses.decoded: And you will not incur any sin because of it, when you have presented the best part of it; nor should you defile the sacred offerings of the Israelites, so that you do not die.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

verses.kjv: This is the ordinance of the law which the Lord hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein is no blemish, and upon which never came yoke:
verses.decoded: This is the regulation of the law which the LORD has commanded, saying, Speak to the children of Israel, that they bring you a red heifer without blemish, in which there is no defect, and on which a yoke has never been placed.

verses.kjv: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and one shall slay her before his face:
verses.decoded: And you are to give her to Eleazar the priest, so that he may bring her out outside the camp, and someone is to kill her in front of him.

verses.kjv: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:
verses.decoded: And Eleazar the priest will take some of its blood with his finger, and sprinkle some of its blood directly in front of the tent of meeting seven times.

verses.kjv: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:
verses.decoded: And someone will burn the heifer in his presence; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, he will burn.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
verses.decoded: And the priest will take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet material, and throw it into the middle of the burning heifer.

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.
verses.decoded: Then the priest must wash his clothes, and he must bathe his body in water, and afterward he must come into the camp, and the priest will be unclean until evening.

verses.kjv: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.
verses.decoded: And the one who burns her must wash his clothes in water, and bathe his body in water, and will be unclean until the evening.

verses.kjv: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up without the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation: it is a purification for sin.
verses.decoded: And a man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and store them outside the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the assembly of the Israelites for water of purification: it is a cleansing for sin.

verses.kjv: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.
verses.decoded: And the one who gathers the ashes of the heifer must wash his clothes and be unclean until the evening. And this will apply to the children of Israel and to the foreigner who lives among them as a permanent law.

verses.kjv: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.
verses.decoded: Anyone who touches the dead body of any person will be unclean for seven days.

verses.kjv: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.
verses.decoded: He must cleanse himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he will be clean; but if he does not cleanse himself on the third day, then on the seventh day he will not be clean.

verses.kjv: Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of the Lord; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.
verses.decoded: Whoever touches the dead body of any person who has died, and does not purify himself, defiles the tabernacle of the LORD; and that person shall be cut off from Israel because the water of purification was not sprinkled on him, he will be unclean; his uncleanness remains on him.

verses.kjv: This is the law, when a man dieth in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.
verses.decoded: This is the regulation when a person dies in a tent: everyone who enters the tent, and everything that is in the tent, will be unclean for seven days.

verses.kjv: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, is unclean.
verses.decoded: And every open container that has no lid fastened on it is unclean.

verses.kjv: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
verses.decoded: And whoever touches someone killed by a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a human bone, or a grave, will be unclean for seven days.

verses.kjv: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:
verses.decoded: And for a person who is unclean, they are to take some of the ashes from the burnt heifer used for purification from sin, and fresh water is to be put with it in a container:

verses.kjv: And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:
verses.decoded: And a clean person will take hyssop, and dip it into the water, and sprinkle it on the tent, and on all the vessels, and on the persons who were there, and on anyone who touched a bone, or someone killed, or someone who died, or a grave:

verses.kjv: And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.
verses.decoded: And the clean person will sprinkle the unclean person on the third day and on the seventh day. On the seventh day, he will purify himself, wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and he will be clean in the evening.

verses.kjv: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the Lord: the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.
verses.decoded: But the person who is unclean and does not cleanse himself, that individual will be removed from the community, because he has defiled the sanctuary of the LORD: the water of purification has not been sprinkled on him; he is unclean.

verses.kjv: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even.
verses.decoded: And it will be a permanent regulation for them, that the one who sprinkles the water of purification must wash his clothes; and the one who touches the water of purification will be unclean until evening.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even.
verses.decoded: And whatever the unclean person touches will be unclean; and the person who touches it will be unclean until evening.

verses.kjv: Then came the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.
verses.decoded: Then the Israelites, the entire community, came into the Desert of Zin in the first month. The people settled in Kadesh, and Miriam died and was buried there.

verses.kjv: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
verses.decoded: And there was no water for the community, and they assembled themselves against Moses and against Aaron.

verses.kjv: And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the Lord!
verses.decoded: And the people quarreled with Moses and spoke, saying, We wish that we had died when our relatives died before the LORD!

verses.kjv: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the Lord into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?
verses.decoded: And why have you brought up the congregation of the LORD into this wilderness, so that we and our cattle should die there?

verses.kjv: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.
verses.decoded: And why have you made us come up out of Egypt to bring us into this terrible place? It is not a place for planting seeds, or for figs, or for vines, or for pomegranates; nor is there any water to drink.

verses.kjv: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of the Lord appeared unto them.
verses.decoded: Then Moses and Aaron left the assembly and went to the entrance of the tent of meeting, and they fell face down. And the glory of the Lord appeared to them.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Take the rod, and gather thou the assembly together, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes; and it shall give forth his water, and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock: so thou shalt give the congregation and their beasts drink.
verses.decoded: Take the rod, and gather the assembly together, you, and Aaron your brother, and speak to the rock before their eyes; and it will give forth its water, and you will bring forth water for them out of the rock: so you will give the congregation and their animals drink.

verses.kjv: And Moses took the rod from before the Lord, as he commanded him.
verses.decoded: And Moses took the staff from the presence of the Lord, as he had commanded him.

verses.kjv: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said unto them, Hear now, ye rebels; must we fetch you water out of this rock?
verses.decoded: And Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock, and he said to them, Hear now, you rebels; must we bring you water from this rock?

verses.kjv: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also.
verses.decoded: And Moses lifted his hand, and with his staff he struck the rock twice: and the water flowed out in abundance, and the assembly drank, and their animals also.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and Aaron, Because ye believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, Because you did not believe me, to treat me as holy in the sight of the children of Israel, therefore you will not bring this assembly into the land that I have given them.

verses.kjv: This is the water of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the Lord, and he was sanctified in them.
verses.decoded: This is the water of Meribah, because the children of Israel contended with the LORD, and he was shown to be holy among them.

verses.kjv: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom, Thus saith thy brother Israel, Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us:
verses.decoded: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying, 'Your brother Israel says this: You know all the difficulties that have come upon us.'

verses.kjv: How our fathers went down into Egypt, and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians vexed us, and our fathers:
verses.decoded: Our ancestors went down into Egypt, and we lived in Egypt for a long time; and the Egyptians oppressed us and our ancestors.

verses.kjv: And when we cried unto the Lord, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and hath brought us forth out of Egypt: and, behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of thy border:
verses.decoded: And when we cried to the Lord, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and has brought us out of Egypt; and, look, we are in Kadesh, a city.

verses.kjv: Let us pass, I pray thee, through thy country: we will not pass through the fields, or through the vineyards, neither will we drink of the water of the wells: we will go by the king’s high way, we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed thy borders.
verses.decoded: Please let us pass through your country: we will not pass through the fields or through the vineyards, nor will we drink water from the wells:

verses.kjv: And Edom said unto him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword.
verses.decoded: And Edom said to him, You must not pass by me, otherwise I will come out against you with a sword.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel said unto him, We will go by the high way: and if I and my cattle drink of thy water, then I will pay for it: I will only, without doing any thing else, go through on my feet.
verses.decoded: And the children of Israel said to him, We will go by the main road: and if I and my livestock drink your water, then I will pay for it: I will only,

verses.kjv: And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.
verses.decoded: And he said, 'You shall not pass through.' And Edom came out against him with many people and with a strong army.

verses.kjv: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: wherefore Israel turned away from him.
verses.decoded: Therefore Edom refused to allow Israel to pass through their territory, so Israel turned away from them.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came unto mount Hor.
verses.decoded: And the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came to mount Hor.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the coast of the land of Edom, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron on Mount Hor, near the border of the land of Edom, saying,

verses.kjv: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Israel, because ye rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.
verses.decoded: Aaron will be gathered to his people, because he will not enter the land which I have given to the children of Israel, since you rebelled against my command at the waters of Meribah.

verses.kjv: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor:
verses.decoded: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor:

verses.kjv: And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people, and shall die there.
verses.decoded: And remove Aaron's garments, and put them on Eleazar his son; and Aaron will be gathered to his people, and will die there.

verses.kjv: And Moses did as the Lord commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
verses.decoded: And Moses did as the Lord commanded: and they went up to Mount Hor in the presence of the entire assembly.

verses.kjv: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.
verses.decoded: And Moses removed Aaron's clothes and put them on his son Eleazar; and Aaron died there on the top of the mountain: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.

verses.kjv: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.
verses.decoded: And when the entire assembly saw that Aaron had died, they mourned for Aaron for thirty days, indeed, all the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And when king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south, heard tell that Israel came by the way of the spies; then he fought against Israel, and took some of them prisoners.
verses.decoded: When King Arad the Canaanite, who lived in the south, heard that Israel was coming by the route of the spies, he then fought against Israel and took some of them captive.

verses.kjv: And Israel vowed a vow unto the Lord, and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.
verses.decoded: And Israel made a solemn promise to the LORD, and said, If you will indeed deliver these people into my power, then I will completely destroy their cities.

verses.kjv: And the Lord hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah.
verses.decoded: And the LORD listened to the voice of Israel, and handed over the Canaanites; and they completely destroyed them and their cities: and he named the place Hormah.

verses.kjv: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.
verses.decoded: And they traveled from Mount Hor by way of the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom; and the people became very discouraged because of the journey.

verses.kjv: And the people spake against God, and against Moses, Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, neither is there any water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.
verses.decoded: And the people spoke against God and against Moses, saying, "Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no food, nor is there any water, and we detest this miserable food."

verses.kjv: And the Lord sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.
verses.decoded: And the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and many people of Israel died.

verses.kjv: Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against the Lord, and against thee; pray unto the Lord, that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.
verses.decoded: Therefore the people came to Moses and said, 'We have sinned, because we have spoken against the LORD and against you; pray to the LORD that he take away the serpents from us.' And Moses prayed for the people.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to Moses, 'Make a fiery serpent for yourself, and set it on a pole; and it will happen that everyone who is bitten, when he looks at it, will live.'

verses.kjv: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.
verses.decoded: And Moses made a bronze snake and placed it on a pole, and it happened that if a snake had bitten anyone, when he looked at the bronze snake, he lived.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in Oboth.
verses.decoded: And the Israelites traveled on and camped in Oboth.

verses.kjv: And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched at Ije-abarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.
verses.decoded: And they traveled from Oboth and camped at Ijeabarim, in the wilderness that is east of Moab, toward the sunrise.

verses.kjv: From thence they removed, and pitched in the valley of Zared.
verses.decoded: From there they moved and camped in the valley of Zared.

verses.kjv: From thence they removed, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, which is in the wilderness that cometh out of the coasts of the Amorites: for Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
verses.decoded: From there they moved and camped across the Arnon River, which is in the wilderness that comes from the territory of the Amorites, because Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

verses.kjv: Wherefore it is said in the book of the wars of the Lord, What he did in the Red sea, and in the brooks of Arnon,
verses.decoded: Therefore it is written in the book of the wars of the LORD, what he did in the Red Sea, and in the brooks of Arnon.

verses.kjv: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar, and lieth upon the border of Moab.
verses.decoded: And at the stream of the brooks that goes down to the dwelling of Ar, and lies upon the border of Moab.

verses.kjv: And from thence they went to Beer: that is the well whereof the Lord spake unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.
verses.decoded: And from there they went to Beer, which is the well about which the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, 'Gather the people together, and I will give them water.'

verses.kjv: Then Israel sang this song, Spring up, O well; sing ye unto it:
verses.decoded: Then Israel sang this song, 'Spring up, oh well; sing to it.'

verses.kjv: The princes digged the well, the nobles of the people digged it, by the direction of the lawgiver, with their staves. And from the wilderness they went to Mattanah:
verses.decoded: The princes dug the well; the nobles of the people dug it, under the direction of the lawgiver, with their staffs.

verses.kjv: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:
verses.decoded: And from there to Mattanah, and from Mattanah to Nahaliel, and from Nahaliel to Bamoth.

verses.kjv: And from Bamoth in the valley, that is in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looketh toward Jeshimon.
verses.decoded: And from Bamoth in the valley, which is in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks toward Jeshimon.

verses.kjv: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
verses.decoded: And Israel sent messengers to Sihon, king of the Amorites, saying:

verses.kjv: Let me pass through thy land: we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink of the waters of the well: but we will go along by the king’s high way, until we be past thy borders.
verses.decoded: Let me pass through your land: we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink of the waters of the well: but we will go along by the king's highway, until we are past your borders.

verses.kjv: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
verses.decoded: And Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his territory, but Sihon gathered his people and went out to meet Israel in the wilderness. He came to Jahaz and fought against Israel.

verses.kjv: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.
verses.decoded: And Israel struck him with the edge of the sword, and took possession of his land from Arnon to Jabbok, up to the Ammonites, because the border of the Ammonites was strong.

verses.kjv: And Israel took all these cities: and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the villages thereof.
verses.decoded: And Israel captured all these cities. And Israel lived in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all its surrounding settlements.

verses.kjv: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto Arnon.
verses.decoded: Because Heshbon was the city of Sihon, the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the previous king of Moab and had taken all his land from him, as far as Arnon.

verses.kjv: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon, let the city of Sihon be built and prepared:
verses.decoded: Therefore those who speak in proverbs say, Come to Heshbon, let the city of Sihon be built and prepared.

verses.kjv: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon: it hath consumed Ar of Moab, and the lords of the high places of Arnon.
verses.decoded: Because a fire has come out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon: it has consumed Ar of Moab, and the leaders of the high places of Arnon.

verses.kjv: Woe to thee, Moab! thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: he hath given his sons that escaped, and his daughters, into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites.
verses.decoded: Misfortune to you, Moab! You are ruined, O people of Chemosh: he has given his sons who escaped, and his daughters, into captivity to Sihon king of the Amorites.

verses.kjv: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah, which reacheth unto Medeba.
verses.decoded: We have shot at them; Heshbon has perished all the way to Dibon, and we have devastated them all the way to Nophah, which extends to Medeba.

verses.kjv: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.
verses.decoded: So Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.

verses.kjv: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took the villages thereof, and drove out the Amorites that were there.
verses.decoded: And Moses sent to scout Jaazer, and they captured its villages, and drove out the Amorites who were living there.

verses.kjv: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.
verses.decoded: Then they turned and went up by the road to Bashan. And Og, the king of Bashan, went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
verses.decoded: And the Lord said to Moses, Do not fear him, because I have delivered him into your hand, and all his people, and his land; and you shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon.

verses.kjv: So they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, until there was none left him alive: and they possessed his land.
verses.decoded: So they struck him, and his sons, and all his people, until no one of his was left alive; and they took possession of his land.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan by Jericho.
verses.decoded: Then the Israelites traveled onward and camped in the plains of Moab on the east side of the Jordan River, near Jericho.

verses.kjv: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.
verses.decoded: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

verses.kjv: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: And Moab was greatly afraid of the people, because they were many, and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.

verses.kjv: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time.
verses.decoded: And Moab said to the elders of Midian, Now this company will consume everything around us, just as an ox consumes the grass of the field.

verses.kjv: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which is by the river of the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me:
verses.decoded: So he sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is located by the river in the land of his people, to summon him, saying,

verses.kjv: Come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail, that we may smite them, and that I may drive them out of the land: for I wot that he whom thou blessest is blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.
verses.decoded: Therefore, please come now and curse this people for me, because they are too powerful for me. Perhaps I will be able to defeat them, so that we may strike them and drive them out of the land, for I know that whoever you bless is blessed, and whoever you curse is cursed.

verses.kjv: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.
verses.decoded: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian left with the payment for divination in their hand; and they came to Balaam and spoke to him.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the Lord shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.
verses.decoded: And he said to them, Stay here tonight, and I will bring you a message, as the Lord speaks to me: and the princes of Moab stayed with Balaam.

verses.kjv: And God came unto Balaam, and said, What men are these with thee?
verses.decoded: And God came to Balaam and said, Who are these men with you?

verses.kjv: And Balaam said unto God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: And Balaam said to God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has sent to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Behold, there is a people come out of Egypt, which covereth the face of the earth: come now, curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out.
verses.decoded: Look, a people has come out of Egypt, and they cover the face of the earth. Come now, curse them for me; perhaps I will be able to defeat them.

verses.kjv: And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people: for they are blessed.
verses.decoded: And God said to Balaam, You must not go with them; you must not curse the people, for they are blessed.

verses.kjv: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land: for the Lord refuseth to give me leave to go with you.
verses.decoded: And Balaam got up in the morning and said to the princes of Balak, "Go back to your land, because the LORD refuses to allow me to go with you."

verses.kjv: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come with us.
verses.decoded: And the princes of Moab arose, and they went to Balak, and said, Balaam refuses to come with us.

verses.kjv: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.
verses.decoded: And they came to Balaam and said to him, Balak son of Zippor says this: Please let nothing prevent you from coming to me.

verses.kjv: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming unto me:
verses.decoded: And they came to Balaam and said to him, 'Thus says the LORD, Let nothing, I ask you, prevent you from coming to me:'

verses.kjv: For I will promote thee unto very great honour, and I will do whatsoever thou sayest unto me: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.
verses.decoded: For I will promote you to very great honor, and I will do whatever you say to me; therefore come, I ask you, curse this people for me.

verses.kjv: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the Lord my God, to do less or more.
verses.decoded: And Balaam answered and said to Balak's servants, 'Even if Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do anything less or more.'

verses.kjv: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what the Lord will say unto me more.
verses.decoded: So now, I ask you to stay here tonight, so that I may know what else the LORD will say to me.

verses.kjv: And God came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men come to call thee, rise up, and go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee, that shalt thou do.
verses.decoded: And God came to Balaam at night and said to him, If the men come to call you, rise up and go with them; but only the word which I will say to you, that you shall do.

verses.kjv: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.
verses.decoded: And Balaam got up in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.

verses.kjv: And God’s anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of the Lord stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants were with him.
verses.decoded: And God's anger was ignited because he went, and the angel of the Lord stood in the way as an adversary against him. Now he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.

verses.kjv: And the ass saw the angel of the Lord standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.
verses.decoded: And the donkey saw the angel of the Lord standing in the path, with his sword drawn in his hand. And the donkey turned off the path and went into the field. And Balaam struck the donkey to get her back on the path.

verses.kjv: But the angel of the Lord stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
