verses.decoded: But the angel of the LORD stood in a path through the vineyards, with a wall on one side and a wall on the other side.

verses.kjv: And when the ass saw the angel of the Lord, she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall: and he smote her again.
verses.decoded: And when the donkey saw the angel of the Lord, it pressed itself against the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall: and he struck it again.

verses.kjv: And the angel of the Lord went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
verses.decoded: And the angel of the LORD went farther, and stood in a narrow place, where there was no way to turn either to the right or to the left.

verses.kjv: And when the ass saw the angel of the Lord, she fell down under Balaam: and Balaam’s anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with a staff.
verses.decoded: And when the donkey saw the angel of the Lord, it fell down under Balaam; and Balaam became angry and struck the donkey with a staff.

verses.kjv: And the Lord opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?
verses.decoded: And the LORD opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?

verses.kjv: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in mine hand, for now would I kill thee.
verses.decoded: And Balaam said to the donkey, "Because you have mocked me: I wish there were a sword in my hand, for now I would kill you."

verses.kjv: And the ass said unto Balaam, Am not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden ever since I was thine unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? And he said, Nay.
verses.decoded: And the donkey said to Balaam, Am I not your donkey, on which you have ridden ever since I belonged to you until this day? Was I ever accustomed to doing this to you?

verses.kjv: Then the Lord opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the Lord standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.
verses.decoded: Then the Lord opened Balaam's eyes, and he saw the angel of the Lord standing in the path, with his sword drawn in his hand. And he bowed his head and fell flat on his face.

verses.kjv: And the angel of the Lord said unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, I went out to withstand thee, because thy way is perverse before me:
verses.decoded: And the angel of the LORD said to him, Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Look, I went out to oppose you, because your way is perverse before me.

verses.kjv: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had slain thee, and saved her alive.
verses.decoded: And the angel of the LORD said to him, Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Look, I went out to oppose you, because your way is perverse before me:

verses.kjv: And Balaam said unto the angel of the Lord, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will get me back again.
verses.decoded: And Balaam said to the angel of the LORD, I have sinned; for I did not know that you stood in the way against me: now therefore, I ask you, allow me to go back.

verses.kjv: And the angel of the Lord said unto Balaam, Go with the men: but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that thou shalt speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
verses.decoded: And the angel of the Lord said to Balaam, Go with the men; but only the word that I will speak to you, that you shall speak.

verses.kjv: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab, which is in the border of Arnon, which is in the utmost coast.
verses.decoded: And when Balak heard that Balaam had come, he went out to meet him in a city of Moab, which is on the border of Arnon, which is at the farthest edge.

verses.kjv: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honour?
verses.decoded: And Balak said to Balaam, Did I not come specifically to you to call you? Why did you not come to me? Am I not truly able to promote you to great honor?

verses.kjv: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto thee: have I now any power at all to say any thing? the word that God putteth in my mouth, that shall I speak.
verses.decoded: And Balaam said to Balak, Look, I have come to you. Do I now have any power at all to say anything? The word that God puts in my mouth, that I will speak.

verses.kjv: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kirjath-huzoth.
verses.decoded: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kirjathhuzoth.

verses.kjv: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that were with him.
verses.decoded: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam and to the princes who were with him.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal, that thence he might see the utmost part of the people.
verses.decoded: The next day, Balak took Balaam and brought him up to the high places of Baal, so that from there he could see the full extent.

verses.kjv: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.
verses.decoded: And Balaam said to Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.

verses.kjv: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram.
verses.decoded: And Balak did as Balaam had said; and Balak and Balaam offered a young bull and a ram on every altar.

verses.kjv: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by thy burnt offering, and I will go: peradventure the Lord will come to meet me: and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee. And he went to an high place.
verses.decoded: And Balaam said to Balak, Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go: perhaps the Lord will come to meet me: and whatever he shows me I will tell you.

verses.kjv: And God met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram.
verses.decoded: And God met Balaam: and he said to him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram.

verses.kjv: And the Lord put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.
verses.decoded: The LORD put a message in Balaam's mouth and said, 'Return to Balak, and this is what you are to say.'

verses.kjv: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.
verses.decoded: And he returned to him, and there he stood by his burnt offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.

verses.kjv: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, saying, Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Israel.
verses.decoded: Then he began his prophetic utterance and said, Balak the king of Moab has brought me from Aram, from the mountains of the east, saying, Come, curse Jacob for me, and come, denounce Israel.

verses.kjv: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? or how shall I defy, whom the Lord hath not defied?
verses.decoded: How can I curse whom God has not cursed? Or how can I defy whom the LORD has not defied?

verses.kjv: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.
verses.decoded: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I see him: indeed, the people will live alone, and will not be counted among the nations.

verses.kjv: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!
verses.decoded: Who can count the countless descendants of Jacob, and the number of a fourth of Israel? Let me die the death of those who are righteous, and let my final outcome be like theirs!

verses.kjv: And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.
verses.decoded: And Balak said to Balaam, What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and, look, you have blessed them completely.

verses.kjv: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which the Lord hath put in my mouth?
verses.decoded: And he answered and said, Must I not be careful to speak what the LORD has put in my mouth?

verses.kjv: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray thee, with me unto another place, from whence thou mayest see them: thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.
verses.decoded: And Balak said to him, Come, I ask you, with me to another place, from where you may see them: you shall see only the outermost part of them,

verses.kjv: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
verses.decoded: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bull and a ram on every altar.

verses.kjv: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I meet the Lord yonder.
verses.decoded: And he said to Balak, Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet the LORD over there.

verses.kjv: And the Lord met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.
verses.decoded: And the Lord met Balaam, and put a message in his mouth, and said, Go back to Balak, and say this.

verses.kjv: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath the Lord spoken?
verses.decoded: When he came to him, he was standing by his burnt offering, with the princes of Moab. And Balak said to him, 'What has the Lord spoken?'

verses.kjv: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:
verses.decoded: And he delivered his prophetic message, and said, Rise up, Balak, and listen; listen to me, you son of Zippor:

verses.kjv: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?
verses.decoded: God is not a human, that he should lie; nor a human being, that he should change his mind: Has he said something, and will he not do it? Or has he spoken, and will he not fulfill it?

verses.kjv: Behold, I have received commandment to bless: and he hath blessed; and I cannot reverse it.
verses.decoded: Indeed, I have received a command to bless; and he has blessed; and I cannot reverse it.

verses.kjv: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: the Lord his God is with him, and the shout of a king is among them.
verses.decoded: He does not observe wrongdoing in Jacob, nor does he see trouble in Israel: the Lord their God is with them, and the shout of a king is among them.

verses.kjv: God brought them out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn.
verses.decoded: God brought them out of Egypt; He has, as if it were, the strength of a unicorn.

verses.kjv: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!
verses.decoded: Certainly there is no magic against Jacob, nor is there any fortune-telling against Israel: at this time it will be said of Jacob and of Israel, What has God accomplished!

verses.kjv: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.
verses.decoded: Indeed, the people will rise up like a great lion, and stand up like a young lion: it will not lie down until it eats its prey, and drinks the blood of those killed.

verses.kjv: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.
verses.decoded: And Balak said to Balaam, Do not curse them at all, nor bless them at all.

verses.kjv: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that the Lord speaketh, that I must do?
verses.decoded: But Balaam answered and said to Balak, Did I not tell you, saying, All that the Lord speaks, that I must do?

verses.kjv: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee unto another place; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.
verses.decoded: And Balak said to Balaam, "Come, I ask you, I will bring you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse them for me from there."

verses.kjv: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh toward Jeshimon.
verses.decoded: And Balak brought Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks toward Jeshimon.

verses.kjv: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
verses.decoded: And Balaam said to Balak, Build for me here seven altars, and prepare for me here seven bullocks and seven rams.

verses.kjv: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
verses.decoded: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bull and a ram on every altar.

verses.kjv: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the Lord to bless Israel, he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
verses.decoded: When Balaam saw that the LORD was pleased to bless Israel, he did not go, as he had at other times, to seek omens, but he turned his face toward the wilderness.

verses.kjv: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel abiding in his tents according to their tribes; and the spirit of God came upon him.
verses.decoded: And Balaam looked up, and he saw Israel living in their tents according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came upon him.

verses.kjv: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
verses.decoded: Then he began his prophetic utterance and said, Balaam, son of Beor, has said, and the man whose eyes are open has said:

verses.kjv: He hath said, which heard the words of God, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:
verses.decoded: He has said, who heard the words of God, who saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but with his eyes open.

verses.kjv: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel!
verses.decoded: How beautiful are your tents, O Jacob, and your dwellings, O Israel!

verses.kjv: As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river’s side, as the trees of lign aloes which the Lord hath planted, and as cedar trees beside the waters.
verses.decoded: As the valleys are spread out, as gardens beside the river, as the trees of lign aloes which the LORD has planted, and as cedar trees beside the water.

verses.kjv: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed shall be in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.
verses.decoded: He will pour water from his buckets, and his descendants will be widespread, and his king will be greater than Agag, and his kingdom will be elevated.

verses.kjv: God brought him forth out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows.
verses.decoded: God brought him out of Egypt; he has, as it were, the strength of a wild ox: he will consume the nations that are his enemies, and will break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows.

verses.kjv: He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee.
verses.decoded: He crouched, he lay down like a lion, and like a mighty lion: who will rouse him? Blessed is the one who blesses you, and cursed is the one who curses you.

verses.kjv: And Balak’s anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said unto Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed them these three times.
verses.decoded: And Balak became very angry with Balaam, and he clapped his hands together: and Balak said to Balaam, I called you to curse my enemies, and, indeed, you have blessed them entirely.

verses.kjv: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honour; but, lo, the Lord hath kept thee back from honour.
verses.decoded: Therefore now flee you to your place: I thought to promote you to great honor; but, look, the LORD has kept you back from honor.

verses.kjv: And Balaam said unto Balak, Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: And Balaam said to Balak, Did I not also speak to your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,

verses.kjv: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the commandment of the Lord, to do either good or bad of mine own mind; but what the Lord saith, that will I speak?
verses.decoded: Even if Balak were to give me his house filled with silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the command of the Lord, to do anything good or bad on my own.

verses.kjv: And now, behold, I go unto my people: come therefore, and I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.
verses.decoded: And now, look, I am going to my people: come therefore, and I will inform you what this people will do to your people in the future days.

verses.kjv: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
verses.decoded: And he delivered his prophecy, and said, Balaam the son of Beor has said, and the man whose eyes are open has said:

verses.kjv: He hath said, which heard the words of God, and knew the knowledge of the most High, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:
verses.decoded: He has said, who heard the words of God, and knew the knowledge of the Most High, who saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but with his eyes open.

verses.kjv: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.
verses.decoded: I will see him, but not now: I will see him, but not near: a Star will come from Jacob, and a Scepter will rise from Israel, and will strike the borders of Moab, and destroy all the descendants of Sheth.

verses.kjv: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies; and Israel shall do valiantly.
verses.decoded: And Edom will become a possession, Seir will also become a possession for its enemies; and Israel will act with strength.

verses.kjv: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city.
verses.decoded: From Jacob will come one who will have dominion, and will destroy those who remain in the city.

verses.kjv: And when he looked on Amalek, he took up his parable, and said, Amalek was the first of the nations; but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever.
verses.decoded: And when he looked at Amalek, he began his prophecy, and said, Amalek was the first of the nations; but its end will be that it will perish forever.

verses.kjv: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwellingplace, and thou puttest thy nest in a rock.
verses.decoded: And he looked at the Kenites, and delivered his prophecy, and said, Your dwelling place is strong, and you place your nest in a rock.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted, until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.
verses.decoded: However, the Kenite will be destroyed until Asshur takes you captive.

verses.kjv: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God doeth this!
verses.decoded: And he began his solemn declaration, saying, Oh no, who will live when God does this!

verses.kjv: And ships shall come from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever.
verses.decoded: And ships will come from the coast of Chittim, and will oppress Asshur, and will oppress Eber, and he also will be destroyed forever.

verses.kjv: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place: and Balak also went his way.
verses.decoded: And Balaam arose, and returned to his place; and Balak also departed.

verses.kjv: And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.
verses.decoded: And Israel stayed in Shittim, and the people began to engage in sexual immorality with the women of Moab.

verses.kjv: And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.
verses.decoded: And they invited the people to the sacrifices of their gods: and the people ate, and bowed down to their gods.

verses.kjv: And Israel joined himself unto Baal-peor: and the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel.
verses.decoded: And Israel joined himself to Baalpeor, and the anger of the LORD was aroused against Israel.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up before the Lord against the sun, that the fierce anger of the Lord may be turned away from Israel.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to Moses, Take all the leaders of the people, and hang them up before the LORD in the sight of the sun, so that the fierce anger of the LORD may be turned away from Israel.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baal-peor.
verses.decoded: And Moses said to the judges of Israel, Each of you put to death his men who were joined to Baalpeor.

verses.kjv: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who were weeping before the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.decoded: And look, one of the Israelites came and brought to his brothers a Midianite woman in the presence of Moses, and in the presence of the entire assembly of the Israelites, who were weeping before the entrance of the meeting tent.

verses.kjv: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from among the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand;
verses.decoded: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he stood up from among the assembly, and took a javelin in his hand.

verses.kjv: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: And he followed the Israelite man into the tent, and pierced him with a spear, and the woman through her abdomen. So the plague stopped among the Israelites.

verses.kjv: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.
verses.decoded: And those who died from the plague were twenty-four thousand.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.
verses.decoded: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my anger away from the Israelites, because he was passionate on my behalf among them, so that I did not destroy the Israelites in my fierce indignation.

verses.kjv: Wherefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:
verses.decoded: Therefore say, Indeed, I give to him my covenant of peace:

verses.kjv: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, even the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his God, and made an atonement for the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: And he will have it, and his descendants after him, even the agreement of a lasting priesthood; because he was devoted to his God, and made reconciliation for the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain, even that was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites.
verses.decoded: Now the name of the Israelite who was killed, even the one who was killed with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a leader of a prominent family.

verses.kjv: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was head over a people, and of a chief house in Midian.
verses.decoded: The name of the Midianite woman who was killed was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was the leader of a people and of a prominent family in Midian.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Vex the Midianites, and smite them:
verses.decoded: Harass the Midianites and strike them down:

verses.kjv: For they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor’s sake.
verses.decoded: Because they trouble you with their deceptive tricks, by which they deceived you regarding Peor, and regarding Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, who was killed during the plague because of Peor.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after the plague, that the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
verses.decoded: And it happened after the plague, that the LORD spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

verses.kjv: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, throughout their fathers’ house, all that are able to go to war in Israel.
verses.decoded: Take a census of all the community of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and older, according to their ancestral households, all who are able to go to war.

verses.kjv: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
verses.decoded: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan near Jericho, saying,

verses.kjv: Take the sum of the people, from twenty years old and upward; as the Lord commanded Moses and the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt.
verses.decoded: Take a census of the people from twenty years old and older, just as the LORD commanded Moses and the Israelites who came out of the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the children of Reuben; Hanoch, of whom cometh the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:
verses.decoded: And it was said, through these individuals the land will be divided as an inheritance according to the number of names.

verses.kjv: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
verses.decoded: From Hezron came the family of the Hezronites; from Carmi came the family of the Carmites.

verses.kjv: These are the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.
verses.decoded: And these are those who were counted from the families of the Reubenites: forty-two thousand five hundred.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Pallu; Eliab.
verses.decoded: And the sons of Pallu were Eliab.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Eliab; Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This is that Dathan and Abiram, which were famous in the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against the Lord:
verses.decoded: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them along with Korah, when that group died, at the time the fire consumed two hundred and fifty men; and they became a sign.

verses.kjv: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.
verses.decoded: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them along with Korah, when that group died, at the time the fire consumed two hundred and fifty men, and they became a warning sign.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding the children of Korah died not.
verses.decoded: However, the children of Korah did not die.

verses.kjv: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:
verses.decoded: The descendants of Simeon according to their families: from Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; from Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; from Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:

verses.kjv: Of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
verses.decoded: From Zerah came the family of the Zarhites; from Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

verses.kjv: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.
verses.decoded: These are the families of the Simeonites: from Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; from Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; from Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;

verses.decoded: From Jashub, came the family of the Jashubites; from Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

verses.decoded: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were counted among them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.

verses.decoded: These are the sons of Gilead: from Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites; from Helek, the family of the Helekites.

verses.decoded: And from Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and from Shechem, the family of the Shechemites.

verses.decoded: And from Shemida came the family of the Shemidaites; and from Hepher came the family of the Hepherites.

verses.decoded: And Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, had no sons, but daughters; and the names of Zelophehad's daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

verses.decoded: These are the families of Manasseh, and those who were counted among them, fifty-two thousand seven hundred.

verses.decoded: These are the descendants of Ephraim according to their families: from Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites; from Becher, the family of the Bachrites; from Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

verses.kjv: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
verses.decoded: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: from Eran, the family of the Eranites.

verses.kjv: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.
verses.decoded: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim, according to those who were counted among them, thirty-two thousand five hundred.

verses.decoded: The descendants of Benjamin according to their families were: from Bela, the family of the Belaites; from Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; from Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites.

verses.kjv: Of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
verses.decoded: From Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites; from Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard, the family of the Ardites: and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
verses.decoded: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: from Ard came the family of the Ardites; and from Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

verses.decoded: These are the descendants of Benjamin according to their families: and those who were counted among them were forty-five thousand six hundred.

verses.kjv: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.
verses.decoded: These are the descendants of Dan according to their families: from Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan according to their families.

verses.kjv: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred.
verses.decoded: And their number was sixty-four thousand three hundred.

verses.decoded: From the descendants of Asher, according to their families: from Jimna, the family of the Jimnites; from Jesui, the family of the Jesuites; from Beriah, the family of the Beriites.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
verses.decoded: From the sons of Beriah: from Heber, the family of the Heberites; from Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

verses.kjv: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Sarah.
verses.decoded: The name of Asher's daughter was Sarah.

verses.kjv: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; who were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.decoded: These are the families of the sons of Asher, according to those who were counted among them, who numbered fifty-three thousand four hundred.

verses.decoded: Regarding the sons of Naphtali, according to their families: from Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; from Guni, the family of the Gunites.

verses.decoded: From Jezer came the family of the Jezerites; from Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

verses.kjv: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and four hundred.
verses.decoded: These are the families of Naphtali, listed by their family groups; and those who were counted among them were forty-five thousand four hundred.

verses.kjv: These were the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.
verses.decoded: These were the individuals counted from the people of Israel: six hundred and one thousand, seven hundred and thirty.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, To these the land shall be divided as an inheritance according to the number of names.

verses.kjv: Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
verses.decoded: To these the land will be divided as an inheritance according to the number of individuals.

verses.kjv: To many thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to few thou shalt give the less inheritance: to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.
verses.decoded: To many you shall give a larger inheritance, and to few you shall give a smaller inheritance: to each person their inheritance shall be given according to the number of individuals.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
verses.decoded: Nevertheless, the land will be divided by lot; they will inherit it according to the names of their ancestral tribes.

verses.kjv: According to the lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few.
verses.decoded: Its possession will be divided by lot among the larger and smaller groups.

verses.kjv: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
verses.decoded: These are the ones who were counted from the Levites according to their families: from Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; from Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; from Merari, the family of the Merarites.

verses.kjv: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites. And Kohath begat Amram.
verses.decoded: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites, and the family of the Libnites again.

verses.kjv: And the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom her mother bare to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
verses.decoded: And Amram's wife was named Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom her mother bore to Levi in Egypt; and she bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

verses.kjv: And unto Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.decoded: And to Aaron were born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.kjv: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the Lord.
verses.decoded: And Nadab and Abihu died when they offered unauthorized fire before the Lord.

verses.kjv: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: And those who were counted among them were twenty-three thousand, all males from one month old and older, because they were not counted among the children of Israel.

verses.kjv: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.decoded: These are the ones who were counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan River near Jericho.

verses.kjv: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.decoded: But among these there was not a single man whom Moses and Aaron the priest counted when they counted the Israelites in the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.kjv: For the Lord had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.decoded: Because the LORD had said about them, 'They will certainly die in the wilderness.' And not one man among them remained, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh and Joshua the son of Nun.

verses.kjv: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.decoded: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, son of Hepher, son of Gilead, son of Machir, son of Manasseh, from the families of Manasseh, son of Joseph, came forward. Their names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

verses.kjv: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
verses.decoded: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the leaders and all the assembly, at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the Lord in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.
verses.decoded: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not among those who assembled against the Lord with Korah; rather, he died because of his own sin, and had no sons.

verses.kjv: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.
verses.decoded: Why should our father's name be removed from his family because he has no son? Therefore, give us a possession among our father's brothers.

verses.kjv: And Moses brought their cause before the Lord.
verses.decoded: And Moses brought their case before the Lord.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying, The daughters of Zelophehad speak correctly: you shall certainly give them a portion of an inheritance among their father's relatives; and you shall cause their father's inheritance to pass to them.

verses.kjv: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.
verses.decoded: Zelophehad's daughters are speaking correctly: you must certainly give them a piece of inherited land among their father's relatives; and you must ensure their father's inheritance is transferred to them.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.
verses.decoded: And you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, If a man dies and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.

verses.kjv: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.
verses.decoded: And if he has no daughter, then you will give his inheritance to his brothers.

verses.kjv: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father’s brethren.
verses.decoded: And if he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father's brothers.

verses.kjv: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: And if his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his closest relative from his family, and he shall possess it; and it shall be a legal statute for the children of Israel, as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to Moses, Go up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel:

verses.kjv: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.
verses.decoded: And when you have seen it, you also will be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered.

verses.kjv: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
verses.decoded: Because you rebelled against my command in the desert of Zin, during the dispute of the assembly, to demonstrate my holiness at the water in front of their eyes: which is the water of Meribah in Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin.

verses.kjv: And Moses spake unto the Lord, saying,
verses.decoded: And Moses spoke to the LORD, saying,

verses.kjv: Let the Lord, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,
verses.decoded: May the LORD, the God of the spirits of all living beings, appoint a leader for the community,

verses.kjv: Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the Lord be not as sheep which have no shepherd.
verses.decoded: Who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in; so that the assembly of the.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him;
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to Moses, Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom the spirit is, and lay your hand upon him;

verses.kjv: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.
verses.decoded: And present him before Eleazar the priest, and before the entire assembly; and give him a commission in their presence.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.
verses.decoded: And you shall put some of your authority on him, so that all the assembly of the Israelites may be obedient.

verses.kjv: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the Lord: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.
verses.decoded: And he will stand before Eleazar the priest, who will seek guidance for him according to the decision of the Urim before the LORD: at his command they will go out, and at his command they will come in, both he and all the people of Israel with him, even the entire assembly.

verses.kjv: And Moses did as the Lord commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:
verses.decoded: Moses did as the Lord commanded him. He took Joshua and presented him to Eleazar the priest and to the entire assembly.

verses.kjv: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses.
verses.decoded: And he placed his hands on him, and commissioned him, as the Lord commanded through Moses.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, for a sweet savour unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.
verses.decoded: Command the children of Israel, and say to them, 'My offering, and My food for My sacrifices made by fire, as a pleasing aroma to Me, you must be careful to offer to Me at their appointed time.'

verses.kjv: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the Lord; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
verses.decoded: And you shall say to them, 'This is the offering made by fire which you shall present to the Lord: two lambs in their first year, without blemish, daily, for a continual burnt offering.'

verses.kjv: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;
verses.decoded: You shall offer one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb in the evening;

verses.kjv: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil.
verses.decoded: And one-tenth of an ephah of flour for a grain offering, mixed with one-fourth of a hin of pressed oil.

verses.kjv: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord.
verses.decoded: It is a regular burnt offering, which was commanded on Mount Sinai as a pleasing aroma, a sacrifice made by fire to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the Lord for a drink offering.
verses.decoded: Its drink offering will be one-fourth of a hin for each lamb; in the holy place you shall pour out the strong wine to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer it, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.decoded: And you shall offer the other lamb in the evening: as the grain offering of the morning, and its drink offering, you shall offer it, a sacrifice made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:
verses.decoded: On the Sabbath day, two lambs one year old without blemish, and two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a grain offering, mixed with oil, and its drink offering.

verses.kjv: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
verses.decoded: This is the burnt offering for every Sabbath, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.

verses.kjv: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the Lord; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;
verses.decoded: And at the beginning of your months you shall offer a burnt offering to the Lord: two young bulls, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish.

verses.kjv: And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;
verses.decoded: And three-tenths of an ephah of flour for a grain offering, mixed with oil, for one bull; and two-tenths of an ephah of flour for a grain offering, mixed with oil, for one ram;

verses.kjv: And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord.
verses.decoded: And a separate tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with olive oil as a grain offering for each lamb; as a burnt offering of a pleasing aroma, a food offering made by fire to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third part of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
verses.decoded: And their drink offerings will be half a hin of wine for a bull, and a third of a hin for a ram, and a fourth of a hin for a lamb.

verses.kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the Lord shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
verses.decoded: And one young goat for a sin offering to the LORD is to be offered, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.

verses.kjv: And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the Lord.
verses.decoded: And on the fourteenth day of the first month is the Passover of the Lord.

verses.kjv: And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
verses.decoded: And on the fifteenth day of this month is the festival: unleavened bread is to be eaten for seven days.

verses.kjv: In the first day shall be an holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein:
verses.decoded: On the first day there shall be a holy assembly; you shall do no kind of regular work in it.

verses.kjv: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the Lord; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be unto you without blemish:
verses.decoded: But you shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering to the LORD; two young bulls, and one ram, and seven lambs one year old:

verses.kjv: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil: three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram;
verses.decoded: Their grain offering will be made of flour mixed with oil: you shall offer three-tenths of an ephah for a bull, and two-tenths of an ephah for a ram.

verses.kjv: A several tenth deal shalt thou offer for every lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
verses.decoded: You shall offer a tenth of an ephah for each lamb, for all seven lambs.

verses.kjv: And one goat for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you.
verses.decoded: And one goat as a sin offering, to make reconciliation for you.

verses.kjv: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.
verses.decoded: You must offer these in addition to the burnt offering in the morning, which serves as a regular burnt offering.

verses.kjv: After this manner ye shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the meat of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord: it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
verses.decoded: In this way you shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the food offering made by fire, as a pleasing aroma to the Lord: it shall be offered in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.

verses.kjv: And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.
verses.decoded: And on the seventh day you shall have a holy assembly; you shall do no laborious work.

verses.kjv: Also in the day of the firstfruits, when ye bring a new meat offering unto the Lord, after your weeks be out, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work:
verses.decoded: Also on the day of the firstfruits, when you bring a new grain offering to the LORD, after your weeks are completed, you will have a holy assembly; you must not do any regular work:

verses.kjv: But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the Lord; two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year;
verses.decoded: But you shall offer the burnt offering as a pleasing aroma to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven lambs one year old.

verses.kjv: And their meat offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto one bullock, two tenth deals unto one ram,
verses.decoded: Their grain offering of flour mixed with oil was three-tenths of an ephah for one bull, and two-tenths of an ephah for one ram,

verses.kjv: A several tenth deal unto one lamb, throughout the seven lambs;
verses.decoded: Their grain offering shall be of flour mixed with oil, three-tenths of an ephah for a bull, and two-tenths of an ephah for a ram, a tenth of an ephah for each lamb, for all seven lambs.

verses.kjv: And one kid of the goats, to make an atonement for you.
verses.decoded: And one young goat, to make atonement for you.

verses.kjv: Ye shall offer them beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, (they shall be unto you without blemish) and their drink offerings.
verses.decoded: You shall offer them in addition to the regular burnt offering, and its grain offering, (they must be without defect for you) and their drink offerings.

verses.kjv: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing the trumpets unto you.
verses.decoded: In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy assembly; you shall do no regular work: it is a day for you to blow the trumpets.

verses.kjv: And ye shall offer a burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the Lord; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.decoded: And you shall offer a burnt offering as a pleasing aroma to the Lord: one young bull, one ram, and seven lambs in their first year, without defect.

verses.kjv: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram,
verses.decoded: Their grain offering is to be fine flour mixed with olive oil: three-tenths of an ephah for a bull, and two-tenths for a ram,

verses.kjv: And one tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
verses.decoded: And one-tenth measure for one lamb, for each of the seven lambs.

verses.kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you:
verses.decoded: And one young goat as a sin offering, to make atonement for you.

verses.kjv: Beside the burnt offering of the month, and his meat offering, and the daily burnt offering, and his meat offering, and their drink offerings, according unto their manner, for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord.
verses.decoded: In addition to the monthly burnt offering, and its grain offering, and the daily burnt offering, and its grain offering, and their drink offerings, according to their custom, and their drink offerings.

verses.kjv: And ye shall have on the tenth day of this seventh month an holy convocation; and ye shall afflict your souls: ye shall not do any work therein:
verses.decoded: And you shall have on the tenth day of this seventh month a holy assembly; and you shall humble yourselves; you shall not do any work on it.

verses.kjv: But ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the Lord for a sweet savour; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year; they shall be unto you without blemish:
verses.decoded: But you are to offer a burnt offering to the Lord as a pleasing aroma: one young bull, one ram, and seven one-year-old lambs; they are to be without defect.

verses.kjv: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals to a bullock, and two tenth deals to one ram,
verses.decoded: Their grain offering will be of flour mixed with oil, three-tenths of an ephah for a bull, and two-tenths of an ephah for one ram,

verses.kjv: A several tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
verses.decoded: A tenth part for each lamb, for all seven lambs.

verses.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering of it, and their drink offerings.
verses.decoded: One young goat for a sin offering; in addition to the sin offering of atonement, and the regular burnt offering, and its grain offering, and their drink offering.

verses.kjv: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work, and ye shall keep a feast unto the Lord seven days:
verses.decoded: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy assembly; you shall do no regular work, and you shall keep a feast to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord; thirteen young bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year; they shall be without blemish:
verses.decoded: And you shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, as a pleasing aroma to the LORD; thirteen young bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs.

verses.kjv: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto every bullock of the thirteen bullocks, two tenth deals to each ram of the two rams,
verses.decoded: Their grain offering is to be flour mixed with oil, three-tenths of an ephah for each of the thirteen bulls, and two-tenths of an ephah for each ram.

verses.kjv: And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs:
verses.decoded: And one-tenth part for each of the fourteen lambs.

verses.kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.decoded: And one young goat for an offering for sin; in addition to the regular burnt offering, and its grain offering, and its drink offering.

verses.kjv: And on the second day ye shall offer twelve young bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:
verses.decoded: On the second day you shall offer twelve young bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs one year old without blemish.

verses.kjv: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
verses.decoded: And their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs shall be according to their number, as prescribed.

verses.kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering thereof, and their drink offerings.
verses.decoded: And one young goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering, and its grain offering, and their drink offerings.

verses.kjv: And on the third day eleven bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish;
verses.decoded: On the third day, eleven young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old lambs without defect.

verses.kjv: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
verses.decoded: And their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, will be according to their number, as prescribed.

verses.kjv: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.decoded: And one goat for a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering, and its grain offering, and its drink offering.

verses.kjv: And on the fourth day ten bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.decoded: And on the fifth day nine bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs a year old without blemish.

verses.kjv: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
verses.decoded: Their grain offering and their drink offerings for the young bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs will be according to their number, as prescribed.

verses.kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.decoded: And one young goat for a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.

verses.kjv: And on the fifth day nine bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:
verses.decoded: On the fifth day, nine bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs a year old, without blemish.

verses.kjv: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
verses.decoded: And their grain offering and their drink offerings for the young bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, in the prescribed manner:

verses.kjv: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.decoded: And one goat for a sin offering; in addition to the regular burnt offering, and its grain offering, and its drink offering.

verses.kjv: And on the sixth day eight bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.decoded: And on the sixth day eight bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs in their first year without defect.

verses.kjv: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
verses.decoded: Their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs must be according to their number, as prescribed.

verses.kjv: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.decoded: And one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.

verses.kjv: And on the seventh day seven bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.decoded: And on the seventh day, seven young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old lambs without defect.

verses.kjv: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
verses.decoded: And their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, as prescribed.

verses.kjv: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.decoded: One young goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering, and its grain offering, and its drink offering.

verses.kjv: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly: ye shall do no servile work therein:
verses.decoded: On the eighth day, you shall have a solemn assembly; you shall do no laborious work in it.

verses.kjv: But ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord: one bullock, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.decoded: But you are to offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, with a pleasing aroma to the LORD: one bull, one ram, seven lambs in their first year.

verses.kjv: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
verses.decoded: Their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be in proportion to their number, according to the prescribed way.

verses.kjv: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.decoded: And one goat for a sin offering; in addition to the regular burnt offering, and its grain offering, and its drink offering.

verses.kjv: These things ye shall do unto the Lord in your set feasts, beside your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meat offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.
verses.decoded: You shall do these things for the LORD during your appointed feasts, in addition to your vows, your voluntary offerings, your burnt offerings, your grain offerings, and your drink offerings.

verses.kjv: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: You are to do these things for the Lord during your appointed festivals, in addition to your vows and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, your grain offerings, your drink offerings, and your peace offerings.

verses.kjv: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the Lord hath commanded.
verses.decoded: And Moses spoke to the leaders of the tribes regarding the children of Israel, saying, 'This is what the LORD has commanded.'

verses.kjv: If a man vow a vow unto the Lord, or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.
verses.decoded: If a man makes a promise to the LORD, or swears an oath to obligate himself with a commitment; he must not break his word, he must do everything that he has spoken.

verses.kjv: If a woman also vow a vow unto the Lord, and bind herself by a bond, being in her father’s house in her youth;
verses.decoded: If a woman also makes a promise to the LORD, and commits herself by an obligation, while she is in her father's house in her youth.

verses.kjv: And her father hear her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father shall hold his peace at her: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.
verses.decoded: If her father hears her vow and the obligation by which she has bound herself, and her father remains silent about it, then all her vows and the obligation by which she has bound herself will stand.

verses.kjv: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and the Lord shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.
verses.decoded: But if her father forbids her on the day that he hears about it, none of her vows or her obligations by which she has bound herself will be valid: and the LORD will forgive her, because her father forbade her.

verses.kjv: And if she had at all an husband, when she vowed, or uttered ought out of her lips, wherewith she bound her soul;
verses.decoded: And if she had a husband when she made a vow, or spoke anything from her lips by which she committed herself,

verses.kjv: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it: then her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
verses.decoded: And her husband heard it, and said nothing to her on the day he heard it: then her vows will remain binding, and her commitments by which she bound herself will remain binding.

verses.kjv: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it; then he shall make her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, wherewith she bound her soul, of none effect: and the Lord shall forgive her.
verses.decoded: But if her husband rejected her vow on the day he heard about it, then he must make her vow, which she made, and what she spoke with her lips, by which she bound herself, invalid; and the Lord will forgive her.

verses.kjv: But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, wherewith they have bound their souls, shall stand against her.
verses.decoded: But every vow of a widow, and of a divorced woman, by which she has bound herself, will stand against her.

verses.kjv: And if she vowed in her husband’s house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath;
verses.decoded: And if she made a vow in her husband's house, or committed herself by an obligation with an oath;

verses.kjv: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
verses.decoded: And if her husband heard it, and remained silent about it to her, and did not forbid her, then all her vows will stand, and every obligation by which she bound herself will stand.

verses.kjv: But if her husband hath utterly made them void on the day he heard them; then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and the Lord shall forgive her.
verses.decoded: But if her husband has utterly made them void on the day he heard them; then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning a commitment with which she bound herself, shall not stand: her husband has made them void; and the Lord shall forgive her.

verses.kjv: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.
verses.decoded: Every vow and every binding oath to impose a restriction upon herself, her husband may confirm it, or her husband may cancel it.

verses.kjv: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day; then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which are upon her: he confirmeth them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.
verses.decoded: But if her husband remains completely silent about her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows or all her obligations that are upon her; he confirms them because he remained silent about her.

verses.kjv: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them; then he shall bear her iniquity.
verses.decoded: But if he in any way nullifies them after he has heard them, then he will bear her guilt.

verses.kjv: These are the statutes, which the Lord commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter, being yet in her youth in her father’s house.
verses.decoded: These are the regulations that the Lord commanded Moses, regarding a man and his wife, and a father and his daughter while she is still young and living in her father's house.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.
verses.decoded: Take revenge on behalf of the Israelites against the Midianites; afterward you will be gathered to your people.

verses.kjv: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the Lord of Midian.
verses.decoded: And Moses spoke to the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves for the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the Lord of Midian.

verses.kjv: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.
verses.decoded: From each tribe, a thousand men from all the tribes of Israel, you shall send to the war.

verses.kjv: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
verses.decoded: Therefore, from the Israelite forces, one thousand from each tribe were provided, totaling twelve thousand equipped for battle.

verses.kjv: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.
verses.decoded: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand from every tribe, them and Phinehas, the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments and the trumpets to blow in their hands.

verses.kjv: And they warred against the Midianites, as the Lord commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.
verses.decoded: And they waged war against the Midianites, as the Lord commanded Moses; and they killed all the males.

verses.kjv: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
verses.decoded: And they killed the kings of Midian, along with the rest of those who were killed; specifically, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam, the son of Beor, with the sword.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.
verses.decoded: And the Israelites captured all the women of Midian and their children, and took all their cattle, all their flocks, and all their possessions as plunder.

verses.kjv: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.
verses.decoded: And they burned all their cities where they lived, and all their impressive castles, with fire.

verses.kjv: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.
verses.decoded: And they took all the plunder, and all the captured people and animals.

verses.kjv: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.decoded: And they brought the captives, and the plunder, and the loot, to Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and to the assembly of the people of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan near Jericho.

verses.kjv: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.
verses.decoded: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the leaders of the assembly, went out to meet them outside the camp.

verses.kjv: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, with the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle.
verses.decoded: And Moses was angry with the officers of the army, with the commanders over thousands, and commanders over hundreds, who came from the battle.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?
verses.decoded: And Moses said to them, Have you saved all the women alive?

verses.kjv: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the Lord in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the Lord.
verses.decoded: Indeed, these caused the Israelites, through Balaam's advice, to act unfaithfully against the Lord in the incident at Peor, and a plague occurred among the Lord's community.

verses.kjv: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.
verses.decoded: Therefore, kill every male child, and kill every woman who has had sexual relations with a man.

verses.kjv: But all the women children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
verses.decoded: But all the young women who have not had sexual relations with a man, keep alive for yourselves.

verses.kjv: And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.
verses.decoded: And you are to remain outside the camp for seven days. Whoever has killed anyone, and whoever has touched anyone who was killed, both of you must purify yourselves and your captives on the seventh day.

verses.kjv: And purify all your raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood.
verses.decoded: And purify all your clothing, and all that is made of animal skins, and all items made of goat hair, and all things made of wood.

verses.kjv: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle, This is the ordinance of the law which the Lord commanded Moses;
verses.decoded: And Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, This is the regulation of the law which the LORD commanded Moses;

verses.kjv: Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
verses.decoded: Only the gold, the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

verses.kjv: Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.
verses.decoded: Everything that can withstand fire, you must put through the fire, and it will be clean; however, it must also be purified with the water of purification. And everything that cannot withstand fire, you must put through the water.

verses.kjv: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.
verses.decoded: And you will wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you will be clean, and afterward you will come into the camp.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
