verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:
verses.decoded: You, Eleazar the priest, and the chief leaders of the congregation, are to take an accounting of the plunder that was captured, both of people and of animals.

verses.kjv: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:
verses.decoded: And divide the spoils into two parts; between those who engaged in the war, who went out to battle, and between all the assembly.

verses.kjv: And levy a tribute unto the Lord of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:
verses.decoded: And collect a tribute for the LORD from the soldiers who went out to battle: one out of every five hundred individuals, including people, cattle, donkeys, and sheep.

verses.kjv: Take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for an heave offering of the Lord.
verses.decoded: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, as a heave offering to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And of the children of Israel’s half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the Lord.
verses.decoded: And from the Israelites' half, you shall take one out of every fifty, from the people, the cattle, the donkeys, and the flocks, from all kinds of animals, and give them to Eleazar the priest as a contribution to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from the captains of thousands and from the captains of hundreds.

verses.kjv: And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,
verses.decoded: The plunder, which was the remaining spoils the soldiers had taken, consisted of six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,

verses.kjv: And threescore and twelve thousand beeves,
verses.decoded: And seventy-two thousand cattle, and from the herd seventy-two thousand;

verses.kjv: And threescore and one thousand asses,
verses.decoded: And thirty-two thousand people in total, consisting of women who had not had sexual intercourse with a man.

verses.kjv: And thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.
verses.decoded: And a total of thirty-two thousand people, consisting of women who had not had sexual intercourse with a man.

verses.kjv: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:
verses.decoded: And the half, which was the share of those who went out to war, was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep:

verses.kjv: And the Lord’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.
verses.decoded: And the Lord's tribute from the sheep was six hundred and seventy-five.

verses.kjv: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand; of which the Lord’s tribute was threescore and twelve.
verses.decoded: And the cattle were thirty-six thousand; from these, the Lord's tribute was seventy-two.

verses.kjv: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the Lord’s tribute was threescore and one.
verses.decoded: And the donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred; from which the Lord's tribute was sixty-one.

verses.kjv: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of which the Lord’s tribute was thirty and two persons.
verses.decoded: And the people were sixteen thousand; from which the Lord's tribute was thirty-two people.

verses.kjv: And Moses gave the tribute, which was the Lord’s heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: And Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD's heave offering, to Eleazar the priest, and to the sons of Aaron, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,
verses.decoded: And from the half belonging to the Israelites, which Moses separated from the men who went to war,

verses.kjv: (Now the half that pertained unto the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,
verses.decoded: Now the half that belonged to the community was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,

verses.kjv: And thirty and six thousand beeves,
verses.decoded: And six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,

verses.kjv: And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,
verses.decoded: And thirty thousand donkeys and five hundred, and thirty thousand five hundred donkeys.

verses.kjv: And sixteen thousand persons;)
verses.decoded: And sixteen thousand people.

verses.kjv: Even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one portion of fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of the Lord; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: From the Israelites' half, Moses took one out of every fifty, both people and animals, and gave them to the Levites, who were responsible for the Lord's tabernacle.

verses.kjv: And the officers which were over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:
verses.decoded: And the officers who were in charge of thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, approached Moses.

verses.kjv: And they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.
verses.decoded: And they said to Moses, Your servants have counted the men of war who are under our command, and not one man among us is missing.

verses.kjv: We have therefore brought an oblation for the Lord, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the Lord.
verses.decoded: We have therefore brought an offering for the Lord, what every man has obtained, consisting of gold jewelry, chains, bracelets, rings, earrings, and pendants, to make atonement for our lives before the Lord.

verses.kjv: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.
verses.decoded: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, specifically all crafted jewelry.

verses.kjv: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the Lord, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.
verses.decoded: And all the gold from the offering that they presented to the Lord, from the commanders of thousands and from the commanders of hundreds, totaled sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.

verses.kjv: (For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)
verses.decoded: Because the soldiers had taken plunder, each man for himself.

verses.kjv: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, for a memorial for the children of Israel before the Lord.
verses.decoded: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tent of meeting,

verses.kjv: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;
verses.decoded: Now the descendants of Reuben and the descendants of Gad had a very large number of livestock. When they saw the land of Jazer and the land of Gilead, they realized that the place was suitable for livestock.

verses.kjv: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,
verses.decoded: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the leaders of the assembly, and said,

verses.kjv: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
verses.decoded: Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Shebam, Nebo, and Beon.

verses.kjv: Even the country which the Lord smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:
verses.decoded: Even the country which the LORD struck down before the assembly of Israel is suitable land for livestock, and your servants have livestock:

verses.kjv: Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession, and bring us not over Jordan.
verses.decoded: Therefore, they said, if we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants as a possession, and do not make us cross the Jordan.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?
verses.decoded: And Moses said to the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Will your brothers go to war, and will you sit here?

verses.kjv: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the Lord hath given them?
verses.decoded: And why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the Lord has given them?

verses.kjv: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.
verses.decoded: Your ancestors did this when I sent them from Kadeshbarnea to survey the land.

verses.kjv: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the Lord had given them.
verses.decoded: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they disheartened the Israelites, so that they would not go into the land which the LORD had given to them.

verses.kjv: And the Lord’s anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord's anger was ignited against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness for forty years, until the entire generation that had done evil in the sight of the Lord was destroyed.

verses.kjv: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:
verses.decoded: Certainly none of the men who came out of Egypt, from twenty years old and older, will see the land which I promised to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, because they have not completely obeyed me.

verses.kjv: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the Lord.
verses.decoded: Except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun, because they have completely followed the Lord.

verses.kjv: And the Lord’s anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the Lord, was consumed.
verses.decoded: And the Lord's anger was ignited against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness for forty years, until the entire generation that had done evil in the Lord's sight was destroyed.

verses.kjv: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers’ stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the Lord toward Israel.
verses.decoded: And look, you have risen in your fathers' place, an increase of sinful people, to further increase the fierce anger of the Lord toward Israel.

verses.kjv: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.
verses.decoded: For if you turn away from following him, he will again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all these people.

verses.kjv: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:
verses.decoded: And they came near to him and said, We will build sheep pens here for our livestock and cities for our children.

verses.kjv: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
verses.decoded: But we ourselves will go armed and ready ahead of the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place; and our little ones will live in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

verses.kjv: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.
verses.decoded: We will not return to our houses until the children of Israel have inherited each person's inheritance.

verses.kjv: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.
verses.decoded: Because we will not receive an inheritance with them on the other side of the Jordan, or beyond; because our inheritance has been given to us on this side of the Jordan, to the east.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the Lord to war,
verses.decoded: And Moses said to them, If you will do this thing, if you will go armed before the LORD to war,

verses.kjv: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the Lord, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,
verses.decoded: And all of you will go armed across the Jordan before the LORD, until he has driven out his enemies from before him,

verses.kjv: And the land be subdued before the Lord: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the Lord, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the Lord.
verses.decoded: And when the land is conquered before the LORD, then afterward you shall return, and be innocent before the LORD, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the LORD.

verses.kjv: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the Lord: and be sure your sin will find you out.
verses.decoded: But if you will not do so, look, you have sinned against the LORD: and be sure your sin will find you out.

verses.kjv: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.
verses.decoded: Build cities for your children, and enclosures for your sheep; and do what you have promised.

verses.kjv: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.
verses.decoded: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, Your servants will do as my lord commands.

verses.kjv: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:
verses.decoded: Our children, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock will be there in the cities of Gilead.

verses.kjv: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the Lord to battle, as my lord saith.
verses.decoded: But your servants will cross over, every man armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord says.

verses.kjv: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:
verses.decoded: So regarding them, Moses instructed Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the leading men of the tribes of the descendants of Israel.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the Lord, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:
verses.decoded: And Moses said to them, If the descendants of Gad and the descendants of Reuben cross the Jordan with you, every man armed for battle, before the Lord,

verses.kjv: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.
verses.decoded: But if they are unwilling to cross over with you, armed, they will receive possessions among you in the land of Canaan.

verses.kjv: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the Lord hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.
verses.decoded: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the LORD has said to your servants, we will do.

verses.kjv: We will pass over armed before the Lord into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be ours.
verses.decoded: We will cross over, armed, before the LORD, into the land of Canaan, so that the possession of our inheritance on this side of the Jordan may be ours.

verses.kjv: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, even the cities of the country round about.
verses.decoded: And Moses gave to them, specifically to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to half the tribe of Manasseh, the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon, king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og, king of Bashan—the land, with its cities in the surrounding territories, specifically the cities of the surrounding land.

verses.kjv: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
verses.decoded: And the descendants of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,

verses.kjv: And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,
verses.decoded: And Atroth, Shophan, Jaazer, and Jogbehah,

verses.kjv: And Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.
verses.decoded: And Bethnimrah and Bethharan, fortified cities, and enclosures for sheep.

verses.kjv: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,
verses.decoded: And the descendants of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,

verses.kjv: And Nebo, and Baal-meon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.
verses.decoded: And Nebo, and Baalmeon (their names were changed), and Shibmah: and they gave other names to the cities which they built.

verses.kjv: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it.
verses.decoded: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and drove out the Amorites who were in it.

verses.kjv: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.
verses.decoded: And Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived there.

verses.kjv: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havoth-jair.
verses.decoded: And Jair, the son of Manasseh, went and captured its small towns, and named them Havothjair.

verses.kjv: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
verses.decoded: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

verses.kjv: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.decoded: These are the travels of the Israelites, who departed from the land of Egypt with their divisions under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.

verses.kjv: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the Lord: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.
verses.decoded: Moses recorded their departures according to their travels, as commanded by the Lord; and these are their travels according to their departures.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.
verses.decoded: And they left Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of that month; the day after the Passover, the Israelites went out boldly in the full view of all the Egyptians.

verses.kjv: For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which the Lord had smitten among them: upon their gods also the Lord executed judgments.
verses.decoded: Because the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, whom the LORD had struck down among them, the LORD also carried out judgments against their gods.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.
verses.decoded: And the children of Israel moved from Rameses and camped in Succoth.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
verses.decoded: And they left Succoth and camped in Etham, which is at the edge of the wilderness.

verses.kjv: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pi-hahiroth, which is before Baal-zephon: and they pitched before Migdol.
verses.decoded: And they moved from Etham, and returned to Pihahiroth, which is in front of Baalzephon: and they camped in front of Migdol.

verses.kjv: And they departed from before Pi-hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.
verses.decoded: Then they left Pihahiroth, and went through the middle of the sea into the wilderness, and traveled for three days in the wilderness of Etham, and camped in Marah.

verses.kjv: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.
verses.decoded: And they moved from Marah, and came to Elim: and in Elim there were twelve springs of water, and seventy palm trees; and they camped there.

verses.kjv: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.
verses.decoded: And they departed from Elim and set up camp by the Red Sea.

verses.kjv: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
verses.decoded: And they moved from the Red Sea, and camped in the wilderness of Sin.

verses.kjv: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
verses.decoded: Then they departed from Dophkah and set up camp in Alush.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
verses.decoded: And they left Dophkah, and set up camp in Alush.

verses.kjv: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.
verses.decoded: And they moved from Alush and camped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.decoded: And they left Rephidim and camped in the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.kjv: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibroth-hattaavah.
verses.decoded: And they moved from the desert of Sinai, and camped at Kibrothhattaavah.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Kibroth-hattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.
verses.decoded: Then they departed from Kibrothhattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.
verses.decoded: They left Hazeroth and camped in Rithmah.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmon-parez.
verses.decoded: And they left Rithmah and camped at Rimmonparez.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Rimmon-parez, and pitched in Libnah.
verses.decoded: Then they moved from Rimmonparez and camped in Libnah.

verses.kjv: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.
verses.decoded: And they departed from Libnah, and camped at Rissah.

verses.kjv: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.
verses.decoded: And they traveled from Rissah and set up camp in Kehelathah.

verses.kjv: And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.
verses.decoded: And they traveled from Kehelathah and set up camp on Mount Shapher.

verses.kjv: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.
verses.decoded: And they moved from Mount Shapher and camped in Haradah.

verses.kjv: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.
verses.decoded: And they departed from Haradah, and camped in Makheloth.

verses.kjv: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.
verses.decoded: And they traveled from Makheloth and camped at Tahath.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.
verses.decoded: And they left Tahath and camped at Tarah.

verses.kjv: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.
verses.decoded: Then they left Haradah and camped in Makheloth.

verses.kjv: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.
verses.decoded: And they went from Mithcah, and camped in Hashmonah.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.
verses.decoded: And they left Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Bene-jaakan.
verses.decoded: And they left Moseroth, and camped in Benejaakan.

verses.kjv: And they removed from Bene-jaakan, and encamped at Hor-hagidgad.
verses.decoded: And they moved from Benejaakan and camped at Horhagidgad.

verses.kjv: And they went from Hor-hagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.
verses.decoded: And they traveled from Horhagidgad, and camped in Jotbathah.

verses.kjv: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.
verses.decoded: And they moved from Jotbathah and set up camp at Ebronah.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Ezion-gaber.
verses.decoded: And they left Ebronah, and set up camp at Eziongaber.

verses.kjv: And they removed from Ezion-gaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.
verses.decoded: And they departed from Eziongaber and camped in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.

verses.kjv: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
verses.decoded: And they moved from Horhagidgad, and camped in Jotbathah.

verses.kjv: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the Lord, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first day of the fifth month.
verses.decoded: And Aaron the priest went up Mount Hor at the command of the Lord, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, on the first day of the fifth month.

verses.kjv: And Aaron was an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.
verses.decoded: And Aaron the priest went up onto Mount Hor at the command of the Lord and died there, in the fortieth year after the Israelites had come out of the land of Egypt, on the first day of the fifth month.

verses.kjv: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: And King Arad, the Canaanite, who lived in the south in the land of Canaan, heard about the arrival of the Israelites.

verses.kjv: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.
verses.decoded: And they left Mount Hor and camped in Zalmonah.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.
verses.decoded: And they left Zalmonah and camped in Punon.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.
verses.decoded: And they left Punon and camped in Oboth.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ije-abarim, in the border of Moab.
verses.decoded: And they left Oboth and camped in Ijeabarim, on the border of Moab.

verses.kjv: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibon-gad.
verses.decoded: And they left Iim and camped in Dibon-gad.

verses.kjv: And they removed from Dibon-gad, and encamped in Almon-diblathaim.
verses.decoded: And they camped in Almon-diblathaim.

verses.kjv: And they removed from Almon-diblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
verses.decoded: And they moved from Almondiblathaim, and set up camp in the mountains of Abarim, in front of Nebo.

verses.kjv: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.decoded: And they left the mountains of Abarim, and camped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan River near Jericho.

verses.kjv: And they pitched by Jordan, from Beth-jesimoth even unto Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.
verses.decoded: And they camped by the Jordan, from Bethjesimoth as far as Abelshittim in the plains of Moab.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan near Jericho, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
verses.decoded: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, When you have crossed over the Jordan into the land of Canaan;

verses.kjv: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:
verses.decoded: Then you must drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their carved images, and destroy all their cast idols, and completely tear down all their high places:

verses.kjv: And ye shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.
verses.decoded: And you shall drive out the inhabitants of the land and live there, because I have given you the land to possess it.

verses.kjv: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man’s inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.
verses.decoded: And you shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the larger group you shall give a larger inheritance, and to the smaller group you shall give a smaller inheritance: each person's inheritance shall be in the place where their lot falls; according to the tribes of your ancestors you shall inherit.

verses.kjv: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.
verses.decoded: But if you will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then it will happen that those whom you allow to remain of them will be irritants in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and will trouble you in the land where you live.

verses.kjv: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.
verses.decoded: Furthermore, it will happen that I will do to you as I intended to do to them.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)
verses.decoded: Command the descendants of Israel, and say to them, When you come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that will be allotted to you as an inheritance, specifically the land of Canaan with its borders:)

verses.kjv: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:
verses.decoded: Then your southern region will extend from the wilderness of Zin along the border of Edom, and your southern boundary will be the farthest edge of the Salt Sea.

verses.kjv: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadesh-barnea, and shall go on to Hazar-addar, and pass on to Azmon:
verses.decoded: Your border will turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and then continue to Zin. Its extension will be from the south to Kadesh-barnea, and will proceed to Hazar-addar, and then pass on to Azmon.

verses.kjv: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.
verses.decoded: And the border will turn from Azmon to the river of Egypt, and its end will be at the sea.

verses.kjv: And as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.
verses.decoded: And concerning the western boundary, you will have the Great Sea as a boundary; this will be your western boundary.

verses.kjv: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:
verses.decoded: And this will be your northern border: from the Great Sea you will mark out for yourselves Mount Hor:

verses.kjv: From mount Hor ye shall point out your border unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:
verses.decoded: From Mount Hor, you shall mark out your border up to the entrance of Hamath; and the boundary will extend to Zedad.

verses.kjv: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazar-enan: this shall be your north border.
verses.decoded: And the border will extend to Ziphron, and its boundary will be at Hazarenan: this will be your northern border.

verses.kjv: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazar-enan to Shepham:
verses.decoded: And you shall mark out your eastern border from Hazarenan to Shepham:

verses.kjv: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:
verses.decoded: And the boundary will extend from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the boundary will go down and will reach the eastern side of the Sea of Chinnereth.

verses.kjv: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.
verses.decoded: And the border will go down to Jordan, and its boundary will be at the Salt Sea: this will be your land with its surrounding territories.

verses.kjv: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the Lord commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:
verses.decoded: And Moses instructed the Israelites, saying, 'This is the land which you will inherit by drawing lots, which the Lord instructed to give to the nine and a half tribes.'

verses.kjv: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:
verses.decoded: Because the tribe of the descendants of Reuben, according to their ancestral households, and the tribe of the descendants of Gad, according to their ancestral households, have received their allotted land.

verses.kjv: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.
verses.decoded: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side of the Jordan River near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: These are the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.decoded: These are the names of the men who will divide the land to you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

verses.kjv: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.
verses.decoded: And you shall take one leader from every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.

verses.kjv: And the names of the men are these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.decoded: And the names of the men are these: From the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

verses.kjv: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
verses.decoded: And from the tribe of the descendants of Simeon, Shemuel, the son of Ammihud.

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
verses.decoded: From the tribe of Judah, Caleb, the son of Jephunneh.

verses.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.
verses.decoded: And the leader of the tribe of the descendants of Dan, Bukki, the son of Jogli.

verses.kjv: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
verses.decoded: The leader of Joseph's descendants, for the tribe of Manasseh's descendants, was Hanniel, the son of Ephod.

verses.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
verses.decoded: And the leader of the tribe of the descendants of Ephraim was Kemuel, the son of Shiphtan.

verses.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
verses.decoded: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Elizaphan, the son of Parnach.

verses.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
verses.decoded: And the prince of the tribe of Issachar was Paltiel, the son of Azzan.

verses.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
verses.decoded: And the leader of the tribe of the descendants of Asher, Ahihud, the son of Shelomi.

verses.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.
verses.decoded: And the leader of the tribe of the descendants of Naphtali was Pedahel, the son of Ammihud.

verses.kjv: These are they whom the Lord commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
verses.decoded: These are the ones whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan near Jericho, saying:

verses.kjv: Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give also unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.
verses.decoded: Instruct the Israelites to give to the Levites from their inherited property cities to live in; and you shall also give to the Levites pasturelands around the cities.

verses.kjv: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.
verses.decoded: And the cities they will have to live in; and their surrounding areas will be for their livestock, and for their possessions, and for all their animals.

verses.kjv: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.
verses.decoded: And the pasturelands of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall extend from the city wall and outward a thousand cubits in every direction.

verses.kjv: And ye shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits; and the city shall be in the midst: this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.
verses.decoded: And you shall measure from outside the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits; and the city shall be in the middle of it: these shall be to them the surrounding areas of the cities.

verses.kjv: And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites there shall be six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.
verses.decoded: And among the cities which you shall give to the Levites there shall be six cities for refuge, which you shall appoint for the manslayer, so that he may flee there.

verses.kjv: So all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities: them shall ye give with their suburbs.
verses.decoded: So all the cities that you will give to the Levites will be forty-eight cities; you will give these with their surrounding lands.

verses.kjv: And the cities which ye shall give shall be of the possession of the children of Israel: from them that have many ye shall give many; but from them that have few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth.
verses.decoded: And the cities which you will give will be from the property of the Israelites: from those who have many, you will give many; but from those who have few, you will give few. Everyone will give some of their cities to the Levites according to the inheritance they receive.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
verses.decoded: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, When you have come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;

verses.kjv: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.
verses.decoded: Then you shall designate cities for yourselves to serve as cities of refuge for you, so that the killer who unintentionally kills any person may flee there.

verses.kjv: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.
verses.decoded: And they will be to you cities of refuge from the avenger, so that the manslayer does not die until he stands before the assembly for judgment.

verses.kjv: And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge.
verses.decoded: And from these cities that you will give, you will have six cities for refuge.

verses.kjv: Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan, which shall be cities of refuge.
verses.decoded: You are to give three cities on this side of the Jordan, and three cities you are to give in the land of Canaan, that will be cities of refuge.

verses.kjv: These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.
verses.decoded: These six cities will be a refuge for both the Israelites, and for the foreigner, and for the temporary resident among them, so that anyone who accidentally kills a person may flee there.

verses.kjv: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.decoded: And if he strikes him with an iron instrument, so that he dies, he is a murderer: the murderer must certainly be put to death.

verses.kjv: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.decoded: And if he strikes him by throwing a stone with which he could die, and he dies, he is a murderer: the murderer must certainly be put to death.

verses.kjv: Or if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.decoded: Or if he strikes him with a wooden weapon with which he could die, and he dies, he is a murderer: the murderer must certainly be put to death.

verses.kjv: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.
verses.decoded: The avenger of blood himself will kill the murderer; when he meets him, he will kill him.

verses.kjv: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;
verses.decoded: But if someone pushes another person out of hatred, or throws something at them by lying in wait, so that they die;

verses.kjv: Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote him shall surely be put to death; for he is a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.
verses.decoded: Or if he strikes him with his hand out of hostility, causing him to die: the one who struck him will certainly be put to death, because he is a murderer. The avenger of blood will kill him when he encounters him.

verses.kjv: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,
verses.decoded: But if he pushed him suddenly without hostility, or threw something at him without intending to ambush him,

verses.kjv: Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, that he die, and was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:
verses.decoded: Or with any stone that could cause a man to die, without seeing him, and threw it at him, causing him to die, and was not his enemy, nor did he intend to harm him.

verses.kjv: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:
verses.decoded: Then the assembly will judge between the killer and the avenger of blood according to these rulings:

verses.kjv: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.
verses.decoded: And the community shall rescue the killer from the hand of the avenger of blood, and the community shall return him to the city of his refuge, where he had fled, and he shall remain there until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

verses.kjv: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;
verses.decoded: But if the killer comes at any time outside the boundary of his city of refuge, to which he had fled;

verses.kjv: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:
verses.decoded: And if the avenger of blood finds him outside the boundaries of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kills the slayer, the avenger will not be considered guilty of murder.

verses.kjv: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.
verses.decoded: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest; but after the death of the high priest, the slayer will return to the land of his possession.

verses.kjv: So these things shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.decoded: These things will be a legal decree for you throughout your generations in all your places of residence.

verses.kjv: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.
verses.decoded: Whoever kills any person, the murderer shall be put to death based on the testimony of witnesses; but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause that person to die.

verses.kjv: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.
verses.decoded: Furthermore, you must not accept any payment for the life of a murderer who is guilty of a capital crime; instead, he must certainly be put to death.

verses.kjv: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.
verses.decoded: And you shall not accept any compensation for the one who has fled to his city of refuge, so that he may return to live in the land until the death of the priest.

verses.kjv: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.
verses.decoded: Therefore, you must not defile the land where you are, because bloodshed defiles the land, and the land cannot be purified from the blood that is shed on it, except by the blood of the one who shed it.

verses.kjv: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I the Lord dwell among the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: Therefore do not defile the land which you will inhabit, where I dwell; because I, the LORD, dwell among the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:
verses.decoded: And the leading men of the families of the descendants of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, approached and spoke before Moses and before the leaders, the leading men of the Israelites.

verses.kjv: And they said, The Lord commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the Lord to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.
verses.decoded: And they said, The LORD commanded my lord to give the land as an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.

verses.kjv: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.
verses.decoded: And if they marry any of the men from the other tribes of the Israelites, then their inheritance will be taken from the inheritance of our fathers.

verses.kjv: And when the jubile of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.
verses.decoded: And when the Jubilee of the Israelites occurs, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe into which they are received; thus their inheritance will be taken from the tribe of our fathers and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe into which they are received.

verses.kjv: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the Lord, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.
verses.decoded: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the LORD, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph has said well.

verses.kjv: This is the thing which the Lord doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD commands about the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, they may marry whomever they consider best; however, they must only marry within the family of their father's tribe.

verses.kjv: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
verses.decoded: Therefore, the inheritance of the children of Israel will not be transferred from one tribe to another, because every one of the children of Israel must keep their inheritance within the inheritance of their ancestral tribe.

verses.kjv: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.
verses.decoded: And every daughter, who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, must become the wife of someone from a family within her father's tribe.

verses.kjv: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.
verses.decoded: The inheritance shall not transfer from one tribe to another tribe; instead, every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep their own inheritance.

verses.kjv: Even as the Lord commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:
verses.decoded: Just as the LORD commanded Moses, so the daughters of Zelophehad did.

verses.kjv: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father’s brothers’ sons:
verses.decoded: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to the sons of their father's brothers.

verses.kjv: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
verses.decoded: And they married into the families of the sons of Manasseh, the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained within the tribe of their father's family.

verses.kjv: These are the commandments and the judgments, which the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.decoded: These are the commands and the regulations which the LORD commanded through Moses to the Israelites in the plains of Moab by the Jordan River near Jericho.
